```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.FragDec

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Program fragments: decrement, clear, halve

More single-register fragments of register-tape programs, in the style of
`Complexity.LogProg.inc_run`: each is specified by its transitions and proved once against
the program semantics. Counters are the words `Nat.bits n` from cell `0`.

The decrement and clear fragments are in
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.FragDec`, which this file re-exports; this file
has the halving and equality fragments.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.decW` — the decrement of a little-endian word.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.dec_run` — `Nat.bits n ↦ Nat.bits (n - 1)`.
* `Complexity.LogProg.clr_run` — `Nat.bits n ↦ Nat.bits 0`.
* `Complexity.LogProg.half_run` — `Nat.bits n ↦ Nat.bits (n / 2)`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

/-! ## The halving fragment -/

/-- The left walk of the halving: write the carried symbol (the cell to the right), carry the
current one; at the left blank step onto cell `0` and continue. -/
def halfLAct {m : ℕ} {Λ : Type} (r : Fin m) (carry : Option Bool) (hF hT next : Λ)
    (rd : Option Bool) : Action m Bool Λ :=
  match rd with
  | some b => regAct r (some carry) (-1) (if b then hT else hF)
  | none => regAct r none 1 next

section Half

variable {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} {x : List Bool} (P : RProg m d Λ)
  (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (r : Fin m) (hR h0 hF hT next : Λ)
  (hRt : ∀ a w, P.tm.tr hR a w = toEndAct r hR h0 (w r))
  (h0t : ∀ a w, P.tm.tr h0 a w = halfLAct r none hF hT next (w r))
  (hFt : ∀ a w, P.tm.tr hF a w = halfLAct r (some false) hF hT next (w r))
  (hTt : ∀ a w, P.tm.tr hT a w = halfLAct r (some true) hF hT next (w r))
  (hRc : P.call hR = none) (h0c : P.call h0 = none) (hFc : P.call hF = none)
  (hTc : P.call hT = none)

/-- The left-walk state carrying a given optional symbol. -/
def halfSt (h0 hF hT : Λ) : Option Bool → Λ
  | none => h0
  | some false => hF
  | some true => hT

include h0t hFt hTt h0c hFc hTc in
/-- **The shifting walk** of the halving fragment: from the position `k - 1` after the first `k`
letters have been shifted, carrying `w[k]` in the state, the program shifts the remaining
letters one cell left and returns to cell `0` with `w.tail` written.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `k`. Each step writes the carried letter, picks up the letter
under the head and moves left. At the left blank the head moves right onto cell `0`, and the
tape holds `w` with its first letter dropped. -/
lemma halfL_run (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (w : List Bool) :
    ∀ k ≤ w.length,
      rrun P oracle (regCfg c (halfSt h0 hF hT w[k]?) r (FinTM.bufferTape (w.take k ++ w.drop (k + 1)))
          ((k : ℤ) - 1)) (k + 1) =
        regCfg c next r (FinTM.bufferTape w.tail) 0 ∧
      ∀ t < k + 1, ∃ s f q, rrun P oracle (regCfg c (halfSt h0 hF hT w[k]?) r
          (FinTM.bufferTape (w.take k ++ w.drop (k + 1))) ((k : ℤ) - 1)) t =
          regCfg c s r f q ∧ P.call s = none ∧ -1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (k : ℤ) - 1 := by
  have htr : ∀ (cr : Option Bool) a ww, P.tm.tr (halfSt h0 hF hT cr) a ww =
      halfLAct r cr hF hT next (ww r) := by
    intro cr a ww; rcases cr with _ | _ | _
    · exact h0t a ww
    · exact hFt a ww
    · exact hTt a ww
  have hc : ∀ cr, P.call (halfSt h0 hF hT cr) = none := by
    intro cr; rcases cr with _ | _ | _
    · exact h0c
    · exact hFc
    · exact hTc
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    refine ⟨?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    swap
    · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      exact ⟨_, _, _, rfl, hc _, by omega, le_rfl⟩
    rw [rrun_one_reg P oracle r c _ _ _ (hc _), htr, regCfg_read]
    have hrd : FinTM.bufferTape (w.take 0 ++ w.drop (0 + 1)) (((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = none := by
      simp
    rw [hrd]
    simp only [halfLAct]
    rw [apply_regAct]
    simp [List.drop_one]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk
    have hkw : k < w.length := by omega
    have hlen : (w.take k).length = k := List.length_take_of_le (by omega)
    have hsplit : w.take (k + 1) ++ w.drop (k + 1 + 1) = w.take k ++ w[k] :: w.drop (k + 2) := by
      have h1 : w.take (k + 1) = w.take k ++ [w[k]] := by
        rw [List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hkw]; rfl
      rw [h1, List.append_assoc]; rfl
    have hstep : rrun P oracle (regCfg c (halfSt h0 hF hT w[k + 1]?) r
        (FinTM.bufferTape (w.take (k + 1) ++ w.drop (k + 1 + 1))) (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1)) 1 =
        regCfg c (halfSt h0 hF hT w[k]?) r (FinTM.bufferTape (w.take k ++ w.drop (k + 1)))
          ((k : ℤ) - 1) := by
      rw [rrun_one_reg P oracle r c _ _ _ (hc _), htr, regCfg_read, hsplit]
      have hpos : (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = ((w.take k).length : ℤ) := by
        rw [hlen]; push_cast; ring
      have hrd : FinTM.bufferTape (w.take k ++ w[k] :: w.drop (k + 2))
          (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = some w[k] := by
        rw [hpos, FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_append_right le_rfl, Nat.sub_self]; rfl
      rw [hrd]
      simp only [halfLAct]
      rw [apply_regAct]
      dsimp only
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hkw]
      congr 1
      · cases w[k] <;> rfl
      · rw [hpos]
        rcases hk2 : w[k + 1]? with _ | v
        · -- `k + 1 = |w|`: erase the last cell
          have hkl : k + 1 = w.length := by
            by_contra hne; rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)] at hk2; simp at hk2
          have hd1 : w.drop (k + 2) = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)
          have hd2 : w.drop (k + 1) = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)
          rw [hd1, hd2, bufferTape_erase_last]; simp
        · have hd : w.drop (k + 1) = v :: w.drop (k + 2) := by
            rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (by
              by_contra hne; rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)] at hk2; simp at hk2)]
            congr 1
            rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by
              by_contra hne; rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)] at hk2; simp at hk2)] at hk2
            simpa using hk2
          rw [hd, update_bufferTape_cons]
      · simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
    obtain ⟨ihr, ihm⟩ := ih (by omega)
    refine ⟨?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    · rw [rrun_succ_left, hstep, ihr]
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
      · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
        exact ⟨_, _, _, rfl, hc _, by omega, le_rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = 1 + t' := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [rrun_add, hstep]
        obtain ⟨s', f, q, hq, hs', h1, h2⟩ := ihm t' (by omega)
        exact ⟨s', f, q, hq, hs', h1, by push_cast at h2 ⊢; omega⟩

include hRt hRc h0t hFt hTt h0c hFc hTc in
/-- **The halving fragment**: `Nat.bits n ↦ Nat.bits (n / 2)` on register `r` (drop the
first binary digit), head back on cell `0`, head in `[-1, |Nat.bits n|]` throughout.

**Proof sketch.** Walk to the right end of `bits n` (`toEnd_run`), then shift every letter one
cell left while walking back (`halfL_run`), which drops the first letter. Since `bits (n / 2)`
is the tail of `bits n` (`bits_half`), the register holds `bits (n / 2)`. -/
lemma half_run (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ T, rrun P oracle (regCfg c hR r (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits n)) 0) T =
        regCfg c next r (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits (n / 2))) 0 ∧
      ∀ t < T, ∃ s f q, rrun P oracle (regCfg c hR r (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits n)) 0) t =
        regCfg c s r f q ∧ P.call s = none ∧ -1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (Nat.bits n).length := by
  set w := Nat.bits n
  obtain ⟨h1, hm1⟩ := toEnd_run P oracle r hR h0 hRt hRc c w w.length 0 (by simp) le_rfl
  obtain ⟨h2, hm2⟩ := halfL_run P oracle r h0 hF hT next h0t hFt hTt h0c hFc hTc c w w.length
    le_rfl
  have he : w.take w.length ++ w.drop (w.length + 1) = w := by simp
  have hn : w[w.length]? = none := by simp
  rw [he, hn] at h2 hm2
  refine ⟨w.length + 1 + (w.length + 1), ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  · rw [rrun_add, h1]
    convert h2 using 3
    · rw [bits_half]
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t (w.length + 1) with h | h
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, hq1, hq2⟩ := hm1 t h
      exact ⟨hR, _, q, hq, hRc, by omega, hq2⟩
    · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = w.length + 1 + t' := ⟨t - (w.length + 1), by omega⟩
      rw [rrun_add, h1]
      obtain ⟨s', f, q, hq, hs', hq1, hq2⟩ := hm2 t' (by omega)
      exact ⟨s', f, q, hq, hs', hq1, by omega⟩

end Half

/-! ## The equality test of two registers -/

section Eq

variable {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- A configuration with state `s` and the heads of registers `r₁`, `r₂` at `k`. -/
def eqCfg (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (s : Λ) (r₁ r₂ : Fin m) (k : ℤ) : Cfg m Bool Λ x :=
  ⟨some s, c.inputPos, c.workTapes,
    Function.update (Function.update c.workTapePos r₁ k) r₂ k, c.output⟩

/-- Move the heads of `r₁` and `r₂` together. -/
def mv2Act (r₁ r₂ : Fin m) (mv : SignType) (s : Λ) : Action m Bool Λ :=
  ⟨0, fun r => if r = r₁ ∨ r = r₂ then (none, mv) else (none, 0), none, some s⟩

/-- Applying the two-register move action moves both register heads by `mv` and enters `s'`. -/
lemma apply_mv2Act (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (s s' : Λ) (r₁ r₂ : Fin m) (k : ℤ) (mv : SignType) :
    (mv2Act r₁ r₂ mv s').apply (eqCfg c s r₁ r₂ k) = eqCfg c s' r₁ r₂ (k + mv) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero _) ?_ ?_ (by simp [mv2Act, eqCfg])
  · funext r z
    simp only [mv2Act, eqCfg, Action.apply]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  · funext r
    simp only [mv2Act, eqCfg, Action.apply, Function.update_apply]
    by_cases h2 : r = r₂
    · simp [h2]
    · by_cases h1 : r = r₁
      · simp [h1]
      · simp [h1, h2]

/-- The comparison step. -/
def eqCAct (r₁ r₂ : Fin m) (eC eBy eBn : Λ) (a b : Option Bool) : Action m Bool Λ :=
  if a = b then (if a = none then mv2Act r₁ r₂ (-1) eBy else mv2Act r₁ r₂ 1 eC)
  else mv2Act r₁ r₂ (-1) eBn

/-- The return step (reading register `r₁`). -/
def eqBAct (r₁ r₂ : Fin m) (eB l : Λ) (a : Option Bool) : Action m Bool Λ :=
  match a with
  | some _ => mv2Act r₁ r₂ (-1) eB
  | none => mv2Act r₁ r₂ 1 l

variable (P : RProg m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (r₁ r₂ : Fin m)
  (hne : r₁ ≠ r₂) (eC eBy eBn yes no : Λ)
  (hC : ∀ a w, P.tm.tr eC a w = eqCAct r₁ r₂ eC eBy eBn (w r₁) (w r₂))
  (hBy : ∀ a w, P.tm.tr eBy a w = eqBAct r₁ r₂ eBy yes (w r₁))
  (hBn : ∀ a w, P.tm.tr eBn a w = eqBAct r₁ r₂ eBn no (w r₁))
  (hCc : P.call eC = none) (hByc : P.call eBy = none) (hBnc : P.call eBn = none)

include hne in
/-- The two-register view reads register `r₁` at its head position `k`. -/
lemma eqCfg_read₁ (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (s : Λ) (k : ℤ) :
    (eqCfg c s r₁ r₂ k).workTapeSymbols r₁ = c.workTapes r₁ k := by
  simp [eqCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, hne]

/-- The two-register view reads register `r₂` at its head position `k`. -/
lemma eqCfg_read₂ (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (s : Λ) (k : ℤ) :
    (eqCfg c s r₁ r₂ k).workTapeSymbols r₂ = c.workTapes r₂ k := by
  simp [eqCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]

/-- One step of the program from a two-register view at a non-call state is the transition's
action applied to it. -/
lemma rrun_one_eq (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (s : Λ) (k : ℤ) (hs : P.call s = none) :
    rrun P oracle (eqCfg c s r₁ r₂ k) 1 =
      (P.tm.tr s (eqCfg c s r₁ r₂ k).inputSymbol (eqCfg c s r₁ r₂ k).workTapeSymbols).apply
        (eqCfg c s r₁ r₂ k) := by
  rw [rrun_one, rstep_noncall P oracle _ s rfl hs]
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  rfl

include hne hC hCc in
/-- **The comparison walk** of the equality test: from `eC` with both heads after the common prefix
`pre` of `w₁` and `w₂`, the program reaches `eBy` if `w₁ = w₂` and `eBn` otherwise, the heads
within `w₁`'s range.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `u₁`. Equal letters move both heads right and extend the common
prefix. A mismatch, or one word ending before the other, enters `eBn`; both words ending
together enters `eBy`. -/
lemma eqC_run (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (w₁ w₂ : List Bool)
    (h₁ : c.workTapes r₁ = FinTM.bufferTape w₁) (h₂ : c.workTapes r₂ = FinTM.bufferTape w₂) :
    ∀ (u₁ u₂ pre : List Bool), w₁ = pre ++ u₁ → w₂ = pre ++ u₂ →
      ∃ (T : ℕ) (p : ℤ), (pre.length : ℤ) - 1 ≤ p ∧ p < w₁.length ∧
        rrun P oracle (eqCfg c eC r₁ r₂ pre.length) T =
          eqCfg c (if w₁ = w₂ then eBy else eBn) r₁ r₂ p ∧
        ∀ t < T, ∃ q, rrun P oracle (eqCfg c eC r₁ r₂ pre.length) t = eqCfg c eC r₁ r₂ q ∧
          (pre.length : ℤ) ≤ q ∧ q ≤ w₁.length := by
  intro u₁
  induction u₁ with
  | nil =>
    intro u₂ pre e1 e2
    refine ⟨1, (pre.length : ℤ) - 1, le_rfl, by rw [e1]; simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [rrun_one_eq P oracle r₁ r₂ c eC _ hCc, hC, eqCfg_read₁ r₁ r₂ hne, eqCfg_read₂, h₁, h₂]
      have ha : FinTM.bufferTape w₁ pre.length = none := by rw [e1]; simp
      rw [ha]
      cases u₂ with
      | nil =>
        have hb : FinTM.bufferTape w₂ pre.length = none := by rw [e2]; simp
        rw [hb]
        simp only [eqCAct, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [apply_mv2Act]
        simp [e1, e2, sub_eq_add_neg]
      | cons b u₂' =>
        have hb : FinTM.bufferTape w₂ pre.length = some b := by rw [e2]; simp
        rw [hb]
        simp only [eqCAct, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [apply_mv2Act]
        have hneq : w₁ ≠ w₂ := by rw [e1, e2]; simp
        simp [hneq, sub_eq_add_neg]
    · intro t ht
      obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      exact ⟨_, rfl, le_rfl, by rw [e1]; simp⟩
  | cons a u₁' ih =>
    intro u₂ pre e1 e2
    have ha : FinTM.bufferTape w₁ pre.length = some a := by rw [e1]; simp
    cases u₂ with
    | nil =>
      refine ⟨1, (pre.length : ℤ) - 1, le_rfl, by rw [e1]; simp; omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [rrun_one_eq P oracle r₁ r₂ c eC _ hCc, hC, eqCfg_read₁ r₁ r₂ hne, eqCfg_read₂, h₁, h₂,
          ha]
        have hb : FinTM.bufferTape w₂ pre.length = none := by rw [e2]; simp
        rw [hb]
        simp only [eqCAct, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [apply_mv2Act]
        have hneq : w₁ ≠ w₂ := by rw [e1, e2]; simp
        simp [hneq, sub_eq_add_neg]
      · intro t ht
        obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
        exact ⟨_, rfl, le_rfl, by rw [e1]; simp; omega⟩
    | cons b u₂' =>
      have hb : FinTM.bufferTape w₂ pre.length = some b := by rw [e2]; simp
      by_cases hab : a = b
      · subst hab
        obtain ⟨T, p, hp1, hp2, hr, hm⟩ := ih u₂' (pre ++ [a]) (by rw [e1]; simp)
          (by rw [e2]; simp)
        have hstep : rrun P oracle (eqCfg c eC r₁ r₂ pre.length) 1 =
            eqCfg c eC r₁ r₂ (pre ++ [a]).length := by
          rw [rrun_one_eq P oracle r₁ r₂ c eC _ hCc, hC, eqCfg_read₁ r₁ r₂ hne, eqCfg_read₂, h₁,
            h₂, ha, hb]
          simp only [eqCAct, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [apply_mv2Act]
          simp
        refine ⟨1 + T, p, by simp at hp1; omega, hp2, by rw [rrun_add, hstep, hr], ?_⟩
        intro t ht
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
        · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
          exact ⟨_, rfl, le_rfl, by rw [e1]; simp; omega⟩
        · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = 1 + t' := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
          rw [rrun_add, hstep]
          obtain ⟨q, hq, hq1, hq2⟩ := hm t' (by omega)
          exact ⟨q, hq, by simp at hq1; omega, hq2⟩
      · refine ⟨1, (pre.length : ℤ) - 1, le_rfl, by rw [e1]; simp; omega, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [rrun_one_eq P oracle r₁ r₂ c eC _ hCc, hC, eqCfg_read₁ r₁ r₂ hne, eqCfg_read₂, h₁,
            h₂, ha, hb]
          have hab' : (some a : Option Bool) ≠ some b := by simpa using hab
          simp only [eqCAct, hab', ↓reduceIte]
          rw [apply_mv2Act]
          have hneq : w₁ ≠ w₂ := by rw [e1, e2]; simp; intro h; exact absurd h hab
          simp [hneq, sub_eq_add_neg]
        · intro t ht
          obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
          exact ⟨_, rfl, le_rfl, by rw [e1]; simp; omega⟩

include hne in
/-- The return walk of the equality test (reading register `r₁`, whose cells left of the
start are nonblank).

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `n = p + 1`: on a letter of `w₁` both heads move left; at the
left blank both move right onto cell `0` and the state becomes `l`. The heads stay in `[-1, p]`. -/
lemma eqB_run (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (w₁ : List Bool) (h₁ : c.workTapes r₁ = FinTM.bufferTape w₁)
    (eB l : Λ) (hBt : ∀ a w, P.tm.tr eB a w = eqBAct r₁ r₂ eB l (w r₁))
    (hBc : P.call eB = none) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : ℤ), p + 1 = n → p < w₁.length →
      rrun P oracle (eqCfg c eB r₁ r₂ p) (n + 1) = eqCfg c l r₁ r₂ 0 ∧
      ∀ t < n + 1, ∃ q, rrun P oracle (eqCfg c eB r₁ r₂ p) t = eqCfg c eB r₁ r₂ q ∧
        -1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ p := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro p hp _
    refine ⟨?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    swap
    · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      exact ⟨p, rfl, by omega, le_rfl⟩
    rw [rrun_one_eq P oracle r₁ r₂ c eB _ hBc, hBt, eqCfg_read₁ r₁ r₂ hne, h₁]
    have hrd : FinTM.bufferTape w₁ p = none := by rw [show p = -1 by omega]; simp
    rw [hrd]
    simp only [eqBAct]
    rw [apply_mv2Act]
    congr 1
  | succ n ih =>
    intro p hp hpw
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, p = j := ⟨p.toNat, by omega⟩
    have hjw : j < w₁.length := by omega
    have hstep : rrun P oracle (eqCfg c eB r₁ r₂ p) 1 = eqCfg c eB r₁ r₂ (p - 1) := by
      rw [rrun_one_eq P oracle r₁ r₂ c eB _ hBc, hBt, eqCfg_read₁ r₁ r₂ hne, h₁]
      have hrd : FinTM.bufferTape w₁ p = some w₁[j] := by
        rw [hj]; simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hjw]
      rw [hrd]
      simp only [eqBAct]
      rw [apply_mv2Act]
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
    obtain ⟨ihr, ihm⟩ := ih (p - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    refine ⟨by rw [rrun_succ_left, hstep, ihr], fun t ht => ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
    · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      exact ⟨p, rfl, by omega, le_rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = 1 + t' := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [rrun_add, hstep]
      obtain ⟨q, hq, h1, h2⟩ := ihm t' (by omega)
      exact ⟨q, hq, h1, by omega⟩

include hne hC hBy hBn hCc hByc hBnc in
/-- **The equality test**: from `eC` with `Nat.bits a` on `r₁` and `Nat.bits b` on `r₂`, both
heads on cell `0`, the program reaches `yes` if `a = b` and `no` otherwise, heads back on
cell `0`, tapes unchanged; both heads stay in `[-1, |Nat.bits a|]`.

**Proof sketch.** Run the comparison walk (`eqC_run`) from the empty common prefix, reaching
`eBy` or `eBn` according to `bits a = bits b`, which is `a = b` by injectivity of `Nat.bits`.
Then run the return walk (`eqB_run`) back to cell `0`, ending in `yes` or `no`. -/
lemma eq_run (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (a b : ℕ)
    (h₁ : c.workTapes r₁ = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits a))
    (h₂ : c.workTapes r₂ = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits b)) :
    ∃ T, rrun P oracle (eqCfg c eC r₁ r₂ 0) T = eqCfg c (if a = b then yes else no) r₁ r₂ 0 ∧
      ∀ t < T, ∃ s q, rrun P oracle (eqCfg c eC r₁ r₂ 0) t = eqCfg c s r₁ r₂ q ∧
        P.call s = none ∧ -1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (Nat.bits a).length := by
  obtain ⟨T₁, p, hp1, hp2, hr1, hm1⟩ := eqC_run P oracle r₁ r₂ hne eC eBy eBn hC hCc c _ _ h₁ h₂
    (Nat.bits a) (Nat.bits b) [] rfl rfl
  simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero] at hp1 hr1 hm1
  have hiff : (Nat.bits a = Nat.bits b) ↔ a = b :=
    ⟨fun h => bits_injective h, fun h => by rw [h]⟩
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · have hw : Nat.bits a = Nat.bits b := hiff.mpr hab
    rw [if_pos hw] at hr1
    obtain ⟨hr2, hm2⟩ := eqB_run P oracle r₁ r₂ hne c _ h₁ eBy yes hBy hByc (p + 1).toNat p
      (by omega) hp2
    refine ⟨T₁ + ((p + 1).toNat + 1), by rw [rrun_add, hr1, hr2, if_pos hab], fun t ht => ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T₁ with h | h
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, hq1, hq2⟩ := hm1 t h
      exact ⟨eC, q, hq, hCc, by omega, hq2⟩
    · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = T₁ + t' := ⟨t - T₁, by omega⟩
      rw [rrun_add, hr1]
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hq1, hq2⟩ := hm2 t' (by omega)
      exact ⟨eBy, q, hq, hByc, hq1, by omega⟩
  · have hw : Nat.bits a ≠ Nat.bits b := fun h => hab (hiff.mp h)
    rw [if_neg hw] at hr1
    obtain ⟨hr2, hm2⟩ := eqB_run P oracle r₁ r₂ hne c _ h₁ eBn no hBn hBnc (p + 1).toNat p
      (by omega) hp2
    refine ⟨T₁ + ((p + 1).toNat + 1), by rw [rrun_add, hr1, hr2, if_neg hab], fun t ht => ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T₁ with h | h
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, hq1, hq2⟩ := hm1 t h
      exact ⟨eC, q, hq, hCc, by omega, hq2⟩
    · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = T₁ + t' := ⟨t - T₁, by omega⟩
      rw [rrun_add, hr1]
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hq1, hq2⟩ := hm2 t' (by omega)
      exact ⟨eBn, q, hq, hBnc, hq1, by omega⟩

end Eq

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.SavitchARM.Correct
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.SavitchARM.Window
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMLoops

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Savitch's search by iterative deepening

Savitch's register machine (`Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.A`) decides membership by midpoint
reachability over the configuration codes at a radius `s` that bounds the decider's space. When
the space bound `sp` is not computable, the radius is found by **iterative deepening**
([Sip13, §8.1, proof of Theorem 8.5]): this file builds one register machine `D` that, at
`s = 1, 2, …`, runs Savitch's search twice as a block of its own table
(`Complexity.LogProg.Ins.embed`):

* the **edge block** asks whether a configuration with a work head on the window's edge `±s` is
  reachable; if so, the space bound exceeds `s`, and `D` tries `s + 1`;
* otherwise the **accept block** asks whether an accepting configuration is reachable at radius
  `s`, which is membership (window exactness, `Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.mem_iff_reach_of_noEdge`).

The loop stops by `s = sp |x| + 1` (`Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.noEdge_of_lt`). The code
width is `w = (codeK N + 1) · (s + ℓ + 1)`, where `ℓ` exceeds the binary length of `|x|` by one
(`D` computes it by halving `|x|`), so every register stays below `2 ^ (W · W)` for the largest
width `W`, which is `O(sp |x| + logSpace |x| + 1)`. This is the hypothesis of
`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_SPACE`, and with it Savitch's theorem for every space bound
`S ≥ logSpace` ([AB09, Theorem 4.14]; `Complexity.savitch_of_logSpace_le`).

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.DeepenContract` — a register machine with logspace deciders
  that answers membership with registers of `O((sp |x| + logSpace |x| + 1)²)` digits.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.deepen_contract` — the deepening machine meets the contract.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.2.1, Theorem 4.14.)
* [Sav70] W. J. Savitch, *Relationships between nondeterministic and
  deterministic tape complexities*, JCSS 4(2), 1970. (Cited through [AB09].)
* [Sip13] M. Sipser, *Introduction to the Theory of Computation*, 3rd ed., Cengage Learning,
  2013. (§8.1, the proof of Theorem 8.5: the space bound found by trying `1, 2, …`.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM

open Turing Codec

/-- **The deepening machine's contract** for `L` and the space bound `sp`: some register machine
`D`, with logspace deciders `As` as its oracle, halts on every input `x` from the label `l₀` and
the zero register file with the answer `x ∈ L`, along a run whose every register has at most
`C · (sp |x| + logSpace |x| + 1)²` binary digits. It is the hypothesis of
`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_SPACE`. -/
def DeepenContract (L : Language Bool) (sp : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (m d : ℕ) (Λ : Type) (_ : Fintype Λ) (_ : DecidableEq Λ) (D : ARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ)
    (As : Fin d → Language Bool), (∀ j, As j ∈ LOGSPACE) ∧ ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ x : List Bool,
      AHalt D (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) x
        (fun a => PreS D x a ∧ ∀ r, (Nat.bits (a.2.1 r + 1)).length ≤
          C * (sp x.length + logSpace x.length + 1) ^ 2)
        (some l₀, fun _ => 0, none) (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x)

/-! ## The machine

`D` has 25 registers. Registers `0 … 17` hold the search block (`dpρ`: the block's register `r`
is `D`'s register `r`); `D`'s own registers are `18` (`T`, the sum `s + ℓ + 1`), `19` (`W`, the
width), `20` (`C`, a shift counter), `21` (`N`, the input length), `22` (`ℓ`), `23` (`s`) and
`24` (`Z`, the loops' scratch register, always `0` between loops). -/

/-- The labels of the deepening machine for `c` copies of the width step: the two search blocks
(`eb`, `ab`), the setup (`scan` … `sOne`), the block preparation for block `f` (`cb` … `zM`;
`f = false` the edge block, `f = true` the accept block), the next radius (`nxt`) and the
answer (`fin`). -/
private inductive DpLb (c : ℕ) where
  | eb (l : Lb 0)
  | ab (l : Lb 0)
  | scan
  | incN
  | lInc
  | hz
  | hh
  | hi
  | sOne
  | cb (f : Bool) (i : Fin 21)
  | cS (f : Bool) (j : Fin 7)
  | cL (f : Bool) (j : Fin 7)
  | tInc (f : Bool)
  | cT (f : Bool) (i : Fin c) (j : Fin 7)
  | bS (f : Bool) (j : Fin 7)
  | zW (f : Bool)
  | bW (f : Bool) (j : Fin 7)
  | zK (f : Bool)
  | kOne (f : Bool)
  | cC (f : Bool) (j : Fin 7)
  | sh (f : Bool) (j : Fin 9)
  | zU (f : Bool)
  | zV (f : Bool)
  | zM (f : Bool)
  | nxt
  | fin (b : Bool)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- The block's registers inside `D`. -/
private def dpρ : Fin 18 → Fin 25 := Fin.castLE (by omega)

private theorem dpρ_inj : Function.Injective dpρ := Fin.castLE_injective _

private theorem dpρ_ne (r : Fin 18) {r' : Fin 25} (h : 18 ≤ r'.val) : dpρ r ≠ r' := fun e => by
  have h1 : (dpρ r).val = r.val := rfl
  have := r.isLt
  rw [e] at h1
  omega

/-- A copy loop of `D`: `b += a` through the scratch register `24`, exiting at `ex`. -/
private def dpCopyI {c : ℕ} (a b : Fin 25) (ex : DpLb c) (k : Fin 7 → DpLb c) :
    Fin 7 → Ins 25 5 (DpLb c) :=
  ![.jz a (k 4) (k 1), .dec a (k 2), .inc b (k 3), .inc 24 (k 0), .jz 24 ex (k 5),
    .dec 24 (k 6), .inc a (k 4)]

/-- The shift loop of `D`: the block's `rK` times `2 ^ C`, through the scratch register. -/
private def dpShlI {c : ℕ} (ex : DpLb c) (k : Fin 9 → DpLb c) : Fin 9 → Ins 25 5 (DpLb c) :=
  ![.jz 20 ex (k 1), .dec 20 (k 2), .jz (dpρ rK) (k 6) (k 3), .dec (dpρ rK) (k 4), .inc 24 (k 5),
    .inc 24 (k 2), .jz 24 (k 0) (k 7), .dec 24 (k 8), .inc (dpρ rK) (k 6)]

/-- The successor of the `i`-th register clear. -/
private def dpCbEx {c : ℕ} (f : Bool) (i : Fin 21) : DpLb c :=
  if h : i.val + 1 < 21 then .cb f ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ else .cS f 0

/-- The successor of the `i`-th width copy. -/
private def dpCtEx {c : ℕ} (f : Bool) (i : Fin c) : DpLb c :=
  if h : i.val + 1 < c then .cT f ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ 0 else .bS f 0

/-- The first width copy. -/
private def dpCt0 {c : ℕ} (f : Bool) : DpLb c :=
  if h : 0 < c then .cT f ⟨0, h⟩ 0 else .bS f 0

/-- The entry of block `f`. -/
private def dpIn {c : ℕ} : Bool → DpLb c
  | false => .eb .OU
  | true => .ab .OU

/-- The edge block's exits: an edge code is reachable (`true`, next radius) or not (`false`,
prepare the accept block). -/
private def dpkE {c : ℕ} : Bool → DpLb c
  | true => .nxt
  | false => .cb true 0

/-- The edge block's rerouting: decider `2` of the search reads the edge language. -/
private def dpσE : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := ![0, 1, 4, 3]

/-- The accept block's rerouting: the identity on `0 … 3`. -/
private def dpσA : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := ![0, 1, 2, 3]

/-- **The deepening machine** with `c` copies of the width step. -/
private def dpD (c : ℕ) : ARM 25 5 (DpLb c)
  | .eb l => (A 0 l).embed dpρ dpσE .eb dpkE 24
  | .ab l => (A 0 l).embed dpρ dpσA .ab .fin 24
  | .scan => .call 0 .whole [21] .incN .lInc
  | .incN => .inc 21 .scan
  | .lInc => .inc 22 .hz
  | .hz => .jz 21 .sOne .hh
  | .hh => .half 21 .hi
  | .hi => .inc 22 .hz
  | .sOne => .inc 23 (.cb false 0)
  | .cb f i => .clr ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ (dpCbEx f i)
  | .cS f j => dpCopyI 23 18 (.cL f 0) (.cS f) j
  | .cL f j => dpCopyI 22 18 (.tInc f) (.cL f) j
  | .tInc f => .inc 18 (dpCt0 f)
  | .cT f i j => dpCopyI 18 19 (dpCtEx f i) (.cT f i) j
  | .bS f j => dpCopyI 23 (dpρ rs) (.zW f) (.bS f) j
  | .zW f => .clr (dpρ rw) (.bW f 0)
  | .bW f j => dpCopyI 19 (dpρ rw) (.zK f) (.bW f) j
  | .zK f => .clr (dpρ rK) (.kOne f)
  | .kOne f => .inc (dpρ rK) (.cC f 0)
  | .cC f j => dpCopyI 19 20 (.sh f 0) (.cC f) j
  | .sh f j => dpShlI (.zU f) (.sh f) j
  | .zU f => .clr (dpρ rU) (.zV f)
  | .zV f => .clr (dpρ rV) (.zM f)
  | .zM f => .clr (dpρ rM) (dpIn f)
  | .nxt => .inc 23 (.cb false 0)
  | .fin b => .ret b

/-! ## The deciders and the oracle bridges -/

/-- The deciders of the deepening machine. -/
private def dpAs (N : FinNDTM Bool) : Fin 5 → Language Bool :=
  ![inputLenLang, initLang N, acceptLang N, stepLang N, edgeLang N]

/-- Their answers. -/
private noncomputable def dpOrc (N : FinNDTM Bool) : Fin 5 → List Bool → Bool :=
  fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (dpAs N j : Set (List Bool)) V

private theorem dp_mem (N : FinNDTM Bool) (j : Fin 5) (V : List Bool) :
    dpOrc N j V = true ↔ V ∈ dpAs N j := by
  rw [dpOrc, indicator_eq_decide]
  exact @decide_eq_true_iff _ (Classical.dec _)

private theorem dp_rel (N : FinNDTM Bool) (σ : Fin 4 → Fin 5) (hσ : σ 3 = 3) (x : List Bool)
    (s : ℕ) : Rel (dpOrc N ∘ σ) x s = StepRel N x s := by
  funext u v
  apply propext
  rw [rel_iff_orc, stepRel_iff_mem, Function.comp_apply, hσ, dp_mem]
  rfl

private theorem dp_initO (N : FinNDTM Bool) (σ : Fin 4 → Fin 5) (hσ : σ 1 = 1) (x : List Bool)
    (s u : ℕ) : InitO (dpOrc N ∘ σ) x s u ↔
      pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits u) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ initLang N := by
  rw [initO_iff_orc, Function.comp_apply, hσ, dp_mem]
  rfl

private theorem dp_accO (N : FinNDTM Bool) (σ : Fin 4 → Fin 5) (j : Fin 5) (hσ : σ 2 = j)
    (x : List Bool) (s v : ℕ) : AccO (dpOrc N ∘ σ) x s v ↔
      pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits v) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ dpAs N j := by
  rw [accO_iff_orc, Function.comp_apply, hσ, dp_mem]

/-! ## Single steps of `D`'s own instructions -/

section Steps

variable {c : ℕ} {o : Fin 5 → List Bool → Bool} {x : List Bool} {B : ℕ}

/-- `D`'s own increments, clears and answers meet the syntactic preconditions. -/
private theorem dp_pre {l : DpLb c} {v : Fin 25 → ℕ}
    (h : (∃ r l', dpD c l = .inc r l') ∨ (∃ r l', dpD c l = .clr r l') ∨
      (∃ b, dpD c l = .ret b)) : PreS (dpD c) x (some l, v, none) := by
  rcases h with ⟨_, _, h⟩ | ⟨_, _, h⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩ <;>
    exact preS_of_ins (by intros; simp_all) (by intros; simp_all) (by intros; simp_all)
      (by intros; simp_all) (by intros; simp_all)

private theorem dp_inc {l l' : DpLb c} {r : Fin 25} (h : dpD c l = .inc r l') {v : Fin 25 → ℕ}
    (hv : ∀ s, v s ≤ B) : AReach (dpD c) o x (GuardLe (dpD c) x B) (some l, v, none)
      (some l', Function.update v r (v r + 1), none) :=
  AReach.step ⟨dp_pre (Or.inl ⟨r, l', h⟩), hv⟩ (by rw [astep_inc h]; exact AReach.refl _)

private theorem dp_clr {l l' : DpLb c} {r : Fin 25} (h : dpD c l = .clr r l') {v : Fin 25 → ℕ}
    (hv : ∀ s, v s ≤ B) : AReach (dpD c) o x (GuardLe (dpD c) x B) (some l, v, none)
      (some l', Function.update v r 0, none) :=
  AReach.step ⟨dp_pre (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨r, l', h⟩)), hv⟩ (by rw [astep_clr h]; exact AReach.refl _)

end Steps

/-! ## The register file

Between loops `D`'s register file is `dpSt b o`: the block's registers `b` and `D`'s own
registers `o` (`o i` is register `18 + i`). -/

/-- `D`'s register file from its block part and its own part. -/
private def dpSt (b : Fin 18 → ℕ) (o : Fin 7 → ℕ) : Fin 25 → ℕ :=
  fun r => if h : r.val < 18 then b ⟨r.val, h⟩ else o ⟨r.val - 18, by omega⟩

private theorem dpSt_ρ (b : Fin 18 → ℕ) (o : Fin 7 → ℕ) (r : Fin 18) :
    dpSt b o (dpρ r) = b r := by
  simp only [dpSt]
  rw [dif_pos (show (dpρ r).val < 18 from r.isLt)]
  rfl

private theorem dpSt_own (b : Fin 18 → ℕ) (o : Fin 7 → ℕ) (r : Fin 25) (i : Fin 7)
    (h : r.val = 18 + i.val) : dpSt b o r = o i := by
  simp only [dpSt]
  rw [dif_neg (by omega)]
  exact congrArg o (Fin.ext (by dsimp only; omega))

private theorem dpSt_upd_ρ (b : Fin 18 → ℕ) (o : Fin 7 → ℕ) (r : Fin 18) (a : ℕ) :
    Function.update (dpSt b o) (dpρ r) a = dpSt (Function.update b r a) o := by
  funext r'
  simp only [dpSt, Function.update_apply]
  by_cases h : r'.val < 18
  · rw [dif_pos h, dif_pos h]
    have e : (r' = dpρ r) ↔ ((⟨r'.val, h⟩ : Fin 18) = r) := by
      rw [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.ext_iff]
      rfl
    simp only [e]
  · rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h, if_neg]
    intro e
    exact h (by rw [e]; exact r.isLt)

private theorem dpSt_upd_own (b : Fin 18 → ℕ) (o : Fin 7 → ℕ) (r : Fin 25) (i : Fin 7)
    (h : r.val = 18 + i.val) (a : ℕ) :
    Function.update (dpSt b o) r a = dpSt b (Function.update o i a) := by
  funext r'
  simp only [dpSt, Function.update_apply]
  by_cases h' : r'.val < 18
  · rw [dif_pos h', dif_pos h', if_neg]
    intro e
    rw [e] at h'
    omega
  · rw [dif_neg h', dif_neg h']
    have e : (r' = r) ↔ ((⟨r'.val - 18, by omega⟩ : Fin 7) = i) := by
      rw [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.ext_iff]
      dsimp only
      omega
    simp only [e]

private theorem dpSt_bd {B : ℕ} {b : Fin 18 → ℕ} {o : Fin 7 → ℕ} (hb : ∀ r, b r ≤ B)
    (ho : ∀ i, o i ≤ B) : ∀ r, dpSt b o r ≤ B := fun r => by
  simp only [dpSt]
  split_ifs
  exacts [hb _, ho _]

/-- After a block's run, every register is at most `B`: the block's by the block's bound, the
others unchanged. -/
private theorem dp_bd_blk {B M : ℕ} {v₂ v' : Fin 25 → ℕ}
    (f1 : ∀ r', (∀ r, dpρ r ≠ r') → v₂ r' = v' r') (f2 : ∀ r, v₂ (dpρ r) ≤ M) (hM : M ≤ B)
    (hv : ∀ r, v' r ≤ B) : ∀ r, v₂ r ≤ B := fun r' => by
  by_cases h : r'.val < 18
  · have e : r' = dpρ ⟨r'.val, h⟩ := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (f2 _).trans hM
  · rw [f1 r' (fun r e => h (by rw [← e]; exact r.isLt))]
    exact hv r'

/-! ## `D`'s loops -/

section Loops

variable {c : ℕ} {o : Fin 5 → List Bool → Bool} {x : List Bool} {B : ℕ}

/-- A copy loop of `D` (`copy_run`). -/
private theorem dp_copy {src dst : Fin 25} {ex : DpLb c} {k : Fin 7 → DpLb c}
    (hk : ∀ j, dpD c (k j) = dpCopyI src dst ex k j) (h1 : src ≠ dst) (h2 : src ≠ 24)
    (h3 : dst ≠ 24) {v : Fin 25 → ℕ} (hZ : v 24 = 0) (hv : ∀ s, v s ≤ B)
    (hb : v dst + v src ≤ B) :
    AReach (dpD c) o x (GuardLe (dpD c) x B) (some (k 0), v, none)
      (some ex, Function.update v dst (v dst + v src), none) :=
  copy_run h1 h2 h3 (hk 0) (hk 1) (hk 2) (hk 3) (hk 4) (hk 5) (hk 6) v hZ hv hb

/-- The shift loop of `D` (`shl_run`). -/
private theorem dp_shl {ex : DpLb c} {k : Fin 9 → DpLb c} (hk : ∀ j, dpD c (k j) = dpShlI ex k j)
    {v : Fin 25 → ℕ} (hZ : v 24 = 0) (hv : ∀ s, v s ≤ B) (hb : v (dpρ rK) * 2 ^ v 20 ≤ B) :
    AReach (dpD c) o x (GuardLe (dpD c) x B) (some (k 0), v, none)
      (some ex, Function.update (Function.update v 20 0) (dpρ rK) (v (dpρ rK) * 2 ^ v 20),
        none) :=
  shl_run (dpρ_ne rK (by decide)).symm (by decide) (dpρ_ne rK (by decide)) (hk 0) (hk 1) (hk 2)
    (hk 3) (hk 4) (hk 5) (hk 6) (hk 7) (hk 8) _ v rfl hZ hv hb

/-- **The register clears**: from the `i`-th clear, registers `i … 20` become `0`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the number of clears left; each clears one register. -/
private theorem dp_cb_run (f : Bool) : ∀ j i (hi : i < 21), i + j = 20 → ∀ v : Fin 25 → ℕ,
    (∀ r, v r ≤ B) → AReach (dpD c) o x (GuardLe (dpD c) x B) (some (.cb f ⟨i, hi⟩), v, none)
      (some (.cS f 0), fun r => if i ≤ r.val ∧ r.val < 21 then 0 else v r, none) := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro i hi hij v hv
    have r1 := dp_clr (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (l := .cb f ⟨i, hi⟩) rfl hv
    rw [show dpCbEx (c := c) f ⟨i, hi⟩ = .cS f 0 from dif_neg (by show ¬ i + 1 < 21; omega)]
      at r1
    refine reach_of_eq r1 ?_
    congr 2
    funext r
    simp only [Function.update_apply, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_mk]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
  | succ j ih =>
    intro i hi hij v hv
    have r1 := dp_clr (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (l := .cb f ⟨i, hi⟩) rfl hv
    rw [show dpCbEx (c := c) f ⟨i, hi⟩ = .cb f ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ from
      dif_pos (by show i + 1 < 21; omega)] at r1
    refine r1.trans (reach_of_eq (ih (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega) _
      (register_update_le _ _ _ _ hv (Nat.zero_le _))) ?_)
    congr 2
    funext r
    simp only [Function.update_apply, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_mk]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega

/-- **The width copies**: from the `i`-th of the `c` copies, `W` gains `(c - i) · T`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the number of copies left; each is one `copy_run`. -/
private theorem dp_cT_run (f : Bool) : ∀ j i (hi : i < c), i + j + 1 = c → ∀ v : Fin 25 → ℕ,
    v 24 = 0 → (∀ r, v r ≤ B) → v 19 + (j + 1) * v 18 ≤ B →
    AReach (dpD c) o x (GuardLe (dpD c) x B) (some (.cT f ⟨i, hi⟩ 0), v, none)
      (some (.bS f 0), Function.update v 19 (v 19 + (j + 1) * v 18), none) := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro i hi hij v hZ hv hb
    have r1 := dp_copy (o := o) (x := x) (k := DpLb.cT f ⟨i, hi⟩) (src := 18) (dst := 19)
      (fun _ => rfl) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) hZ hv (by omega)
    rw [show dpCtEx f ⟨i, hi⟩ = .bS f 0 from dif_neg (by show ¬ i + 1 < c; omega)] at r1
    exact reach_of_eq r1 (by rw [zero_add, one_mul])
  | succ j ih =>
    intro i hi hij v hZ hv hb
    have r1 := dp_copy (o := o) (x := x) (k := DpLb.cT f ⟨i, hi⟩) (src := 18) (dst := 19)
      (fun _ => rfl) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) hZ hv (by nlinarith)
    rw [show dpCtEx f ⟨i, hi⟩ = .cT f ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 from
      dif_pos (by show i + 1 < c; omega)] at r1
    have e18 : Function.update v 19 (v 19 + v 18) 18 = v 18 :=
      Function.update_of_ne (by decide) _ _
    refine r1.trans (reach_of_eq (ih (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega) _
      (by rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]; exact hZ) (register_update_le _ _ _ _ hv (by nlinarith))
      (by rw [e18, Function.update_self]; nlinarith)) ?_)
    rw [e18, Function.update_self, Function.update_idem]
    congr 3
    ring

/-- The binary length against `logSpace`: `logSpace n ≤ 1 + |bits n| ≤ logSpace n + 1`. -/
private theorem dp_bits_logSpace (n : ℕ) : logSpace n ≤ 1 + (Nat.bits n).length ∧
    (Nat.bits n).length ≤ logSpace n := by
  have h2 : (Nat.bits n).length ≤ logSpace n :=
    (length_bits_le_log n).trans_eq (logSpace_eq n).symm
  rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len] at h2 ⊢
  exact ⟨by have := logSpace_le_size_succ n; omega, h2⟩

end Loops

/-! ## The block preparation -/

/-- **The block preparation** at radius `s`: from `cb f 0`, `D` reaches block `f`'s entry
with the block's registers `setSt`'s and `outerSt`'s chain at radius `s` and width
`w = c · (s + ℓ + 1)`, and its own `ℓ`, `s` and scratch registers unchanged.

**Proof sketch.** Clear registers `0 … 20` (`dp_cb_run`); `T := s + ℓ + 1` (two copies and an
increment); `W := c · T` (`dp_cT_run`); then write the block's `rs := s`, `rw := w`,
`rK := 2 ^ w` (an increment and `shl_run`), `rU`, `rV`, `rM := 0`, each after clearing it, in
that order. Every value is at most `2 ^ w`. -/
private theorem dp_prep {c : ℕ} {o : Fin 5 → List Bool → Bool} {x : List Bool} {B : ℕ}
    (hc : 1 ≤ c) (f : Bool) {s ℓ : ℕ} (hB : 2 ^ (c * (s + ℓ + 1)) ≤ B) {v : Fin 25 → ℕ}
    (hL : v 22 = ℓ) (hS : v 23 = s) (hZ : v 24 = 0) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) :
    ∃ v', AReach (dpD c) o x (GuardLe (dpD c) x B) (some (.cb f 0), v, none)
        (some (dpIn f), v', none) ∧
      (∀ r, v' (dpρ r) = Function.update (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update
        (Function.update (Function.update (fun _ => 0) rs s) rw (c * (s + ℓ + 1))) rK
          (2 ^ (c * (s + ℓ + 1)))) rU 0) rV 0) rM 0 r) ∧
      v' 22 = ℓ ∧ v' 23 = s ∧ v' 24 = 0 ∧ ∀ r, v' r ≤ B := by
  have hw1 : s + ℓ + 1 ≤ c * (s + ℓ + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hc
  have hw2 : c * (s + ℓ + 1) < 2 ^ (c * (s + ℓ + 1)) := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  generalize hw : c * (s + ℓ + 1) = w at hw1 hw2 hB
  have hwB : w ≤ B := by omega
  -- the clears
  have r1 := dp_cb_run (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (B := B) f 20 0 (by omega) rfl v hv
  set o1 : Fin 7 → ℕ := fun i => if i.val < 3 then 0 else v ⟨18 + i.val, by omega⟩ with ho1
  have e1 : (fun r : Fin 25 => if 0 ≤ r.val ∧ r.val < 21 then 0 else v r) =
      dpSt (fun _ => 0) o1 := by
    funext r
    simp only [dpSt, ho1]
    by_cases h1 : r.val < 18
    · rw [dif_pos h1, if_pos ⟨Nat.zero_le _, by omega⟩]
    · rw [dif_neg h1]
      by_cases h2 : r.val < 21
      · rw [if_pos ⟨Nat.zero_le _, h2⟩, if_pos (show r.val - 18 < 3 by omega)]
      · rw [if_neg (fun h => h2 h.2), if_neg (show ¬ r.val - 18 < 3 by omega)]
        exact congrArg v (Fin.ext (show r.val = 18 + (r.val - 18) by omega))
  rw [e1] at r1
  have o1L : o1 4 = ℓ := hL
  have o1S : o1 5 = s := hS
  have o1Z : o1 6 = 0 := hZ
  have o1b : ∀ i, o1 i ≤ B := fun i => by
    simp only [ho1]
    split_ifs
    exacts [Nat.zero_le _, hv _]
  have b0 : ∀ r : Fin 18, (fun _ => 0 : Fin 18 → ℕ) r ≤ B := fun _ => Nat.zero_le _
  -- `T := s`
  have r2 := dp_copy (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (k := DpLb.cS f) (src := 23) (dst := 18) (fun _ => rfl)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (v := dpSt (fun _ => 0) o1)
    (by rw [dpSt_own _ _ 24 6 rfl]; exact o1Z) (dpSt_bd b0 o1b)
    (by rw [dpSt_own _ _ 18 0 rfl, dpSt_own _ _ 23 5 rfl, o1S]; exact (show (0 : ℕ) + s ≤ B by omega))
  rw [dpSt_own _ _ 18 0 rfl, dpSt_own _ _ 23 5 rfl, o1S, dpSt_upd_own _ _ 18 0 rfl,
    show o1 0 + s = s from by simp [ho1]] at r2
  -- `T := s + ℓ`
  set o2 := Function.update o1 0 s with ho2
  have o2b : ∀ i, o2 i ≤ B := register_update_le _ _ _ _ o1b (by omega)
  have r3 := dp_copy (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (k := DpLb.cL f) (src := 22) (dst := 18) (fun _ => rfl)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (v := dpSt (fun _ => 0) o2)
    (by rw [dpSt_own _ _ 24 6 rfl, ho2, Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]; exact o1Z)
    (dpSt_bd b0 o2b)
    (by rw [dpSt_own _ _ 18 0 rfl, dpSt_own _ _ 22 4 rfl, ho2, Function.update_self,
      Function.update_of_ne (by decide), o1L]; omega)
  rw [dpSt_own _ _ 18 0 rfl, dpSt_own _ _ 22 4 rfl, dpSt_upd_own _ _ 18 0 rfl, ho2,
    Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (show (4 : Fin 7) ≠ 0 by decide), o1L,
    Function.update_idem] at r3
  -- `T := s + ℓ + 1`
  set o3 := Function.update o1 0 (s + ℓ) with ho3
  have o3b : ∀ i, o3 i ≤ B := register_update_le _ _ _ _ o1b (by omega)
  have r4 := dp_inc (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (l := .tInc f) rfl (dpSt_bd b0 o3b)
  rw [dpSt_own _ _ 18 0 rfl, dpSt_upd_own _ _ 18 0 rfl, ho3, Function.update_self,
    Function.update_idem, show dpCt0 (c := c) f = .cT f ⟨0, hc⟩ 0 from dif_pos hc] at r4
  -- `W := c · T`
  set o4 := Function.update o1 0 (s + ℓ + 1) with ho4
  have o4b : ∀ i, o4 i ≤ B := register_update_le _ _ _ _ o1b (by omega)
  have o4T : o4 0 = s + ℓ + 1 := Function.update_self _ _ _
  have o4W : o4 1 = 0 := by rw [ho4, Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]; rfl
  have r5 := dp_cT_run (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (B := B) f (c - 1) 0 hc (by omega)
    (dpSt (fun _ => 0) o4)
    (by rw [dpSt_own _ _ 24 6 rfl, ho4, Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]; exact o1Z)
    (dpSt_bd b0 o4b)
    (by rw [dpSt_own _ _ 18 0 rfl, dpSt_own _ _ 19 1 rfl, o4T, o4W,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel hc, hw]; omega)
  rw [dpSt_own _ _ 18 0 rfl, dpSt_own _ _ 19 1 rfl, o4T, o4W, Nat.sub_add_cancel hc, hw,
    zero_add, dpSt_upd_own _ _ 19 1 rfl] at r5
  -- the block's `rs := s`
  set o5 := Function.update o4 1 w with ho5
  have o5b : ∀ i, o5 i ≤ B := register_update_le _ _ _ _ o4b hwB
  have o5S : o5 5 = s := by
    rw [ho5, ho4, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]
    exact o1S
  have o5W : o5 1 = w := Function.update_self _ _ _
  have o5C : o5 2 = 0 := by
    rw [ho5, ho4, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]
    rfl
  have o5Z : o5 6 = 0 := by
    rw [ho5, ho4, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]
    exact o1Z
  have Z5 : ∀ b : Fin 18 → ℕ, dpSt b o5 24 = 0 := fun b => by
    rw [dpSt_own _ _ 24 6 rfl]; exact o5Z
  have r6 := dp_copy (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (k := DpLb.bS f) (src := 23) (dst := dpρ rs)
    (fun _ => rfl) (dpρ_ne rs (by decide)).symm (by decide) (dpρ_ne rs (by decide)) (Z5 _)
    (dpSt_bd b0 o5b) (by rw [dpSt_ρ, dpSt_own _ _ 23 5 rfl, o5S]; show 0 + s ≤ B; omega)
  rw [dpSt_ρ, dpSt_own _ _ 23 5 rfl, o5S, dpSt_upd_ρ] at r6
  simp only [zero_add] at r6
  -- the block's `rw := w`
  set b1 : Fin 18 → ℕ := Function.update (fun _ => 0) rs s with hb1
  have b1b : ∀ r, b1 r ≤ B := register_update_le _ _ _ _ b0 (by omega)
  have r7 := dp_clr (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (l := .zW f) rfl (dpSt_bd b1b o5b)
  rw [dpSt_upd_ρ] at r7
  have r8 := dp_copy (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (k := DpLb.bW f) (src := 19) (dst := dpρ rw)
    (fun _ => rfl) (dpρ_ne rw (by decide)).symm (by decide) (dpρ_ne rw (by decide)) (Z5 _)
    (dpSt_bd (register_update_le _ rw _ _ b1b (Nat.zero_le _)) o5b)
    (by rw [dpSt_ρ, dpSt_own _ _ 19 1 rfl, o5W, Function.update_self]; omega)
  rw [dpSt_ρ, dpSt_own _ _ 19 1 rfl, o5W, Function.update_self, zero_add, dpSt_upd_ρ,
    Function.update_idem] at r8
  -- the block's `rK := 1`
  set b2 := Function.update b1 rw w with hb2
  have b2b : ∀ r, b2 r ≤ B := register_update_le _ _ _ _ b1b hwB
  have r9 := dp_clr (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (l := .zK f) rfl (dpSt_bd b2b o5b)
  rw [dpSt_upd_ρ] at r9
  have r10 := dp_inc (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (l := .kOne f) rfl
    (dpSt_bd (register_update_le _ rK _ _ b2b (Nat.zero_le _)) o5b)
  rw [dpSt_ρ, Function.update_self, zero_add, dpSt_upd_ρ, Function.update_idem] at r10
  -- `C := w`
  set b3 := Function.update b2 rK 1 with hb3
  have b3b : ∀ r, b3 r ≤ B := register_update_le _ _ _ _ b2b (by omega)
  have r11 := dp_copy (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (k := DpLb.cC f) (src := 19) (dst := 20) (fun _ => rfl)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (Z5 _) (dpSt_bd b3b o5b)
    (by rw [dpSt_own _ _ 20 2 rfl, dpSt_own _ _ 19 1 rfl, o5W, o5C]; omega)
  rw [dpSt_own _ _ 20 2 rfl, dpSt_own _ _ 19 1 rfl, o5W, o5C, zero_add,
    dpSt_upd_own _ _ 20 2 rfl] at r11
  -- the block's `rK := 2 ^ w`
  set o6 := Function.update o5 2 w with ho6
  have o6b : ∀ i, o6 i ≤ B := register_update_le _ _ _ _ o5b hwB
  have r12 := dp_shl (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (k := DpLb.sh f) (ex := .zU f) (fun _ => rfl)
    (v := dpSt b3 o6)
    (by rw [dpSt_own _ _ 24 6 rfl, ho6, Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]; exact o5Z)
    (dpSt_bd b3b o6b)
    (by rw [dpSt_ρ, dpSt_own _ _ 20 2 rfl, ho6, Function.update_self, hb3,
      Function.update_self, one_mul]; exact hB)
  rw [dpSt_ρ, dpSt_own _ _ 20 2 rfl, ho6, Function.update_self, hb3, Function.update_self,
    one_mul, dpSt_upd_own _ _ 20 2 rfl, dpSt_upd_ρ, Function.update_idem,
    Function.update_idem] at r12
  -- the block's `rU`, `rV`, `rM := 0`
  set b4 := Function.update b2 rK (2 ^ w) with hb4
  set o7 := Function.update o5 2 0 with ho7
  have b4b : ∀ r, b4 r ≤ B := register_update_le _ _ _ _ b2b hB
  have o7b : ∀ i, o7 i ≤ B := register_update_le _ _ _ _ o5b (Nat.zero_le _)
  have r13 := dp_clr (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (l := .zU f) rfl (dpSt_bd b4b o7b)
  rw [dpSt_upd_ρ] at r13
  have r14 := dp_clr (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (l := .zV f) rfl
    (dpSt_bd (register_update_le _ rU _ _ b4b (Nat.zero_le _)) o7b)
  rw [dpSt_upd_ρ] at r14
  have r15 := dp_clr (c := c) (o := o) (x := x) (l := .zM f) rfl
    (dpSt_bd (register_update_le _ rV _ _ (register_update_le _ rU _ _ b4b (Nat.zero_le _)) (Nat.zero_le _)) o7b)
  rw [dpSt_upd_ρ] at r15
  refine ⟨_, r1.trans (r2.trans (r3.trans (r4.trans (r5.trans (r6.trans (r7.trans (r8.trans
    (r9.trans (r10.trans (r11.trans (r12.trans (r13.trans (r14.trans r15))))))))))))),
    fun r => dpSt_ρ _ _ r, ?_, ?_, ?_, dpSt_bd (register_update_le _ rM _ _ (register_update_le _ rV _ _ (register_update_le _ rU _ _ b4b (Nat.zero_le _))
      (Nat.zero_le _)) (Nat.zero_le _)) o7b⟩
  · rw [dpSt_own _ _ 22 4 rfl, ho7, ho5, ho4, Function.update_of_ne (by decide),
      Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]
    exact o1L
  · rw [dpSt_own _ _ 23 5 rfl, ho7, Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]
    exact o5S
  · rw [dpSt_own _ _ 24 6 rfl, ho7, Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]
    exact o5Z

/-! ## The blocks -/

open Classical in
/-- **A block's fit**: entered at the outer search with the entry registers, the embedded
search exits through `k b`, where `b` says whether some initial code reaches some code of the
language `La` (decider `j`, through `σ 2 = j`) by midpoint reachability at radius `s` and
level `w`.

**Proof sketch.** The entry registers are
`(outerSt s w 0 0 0).toV` (`setSt_toV`, `outerSt_toV`), so one `AHalt.embed_guardLe` of
`outerU_run` (with `A_noVal`) runs the block to its exit; its answer is converted to the codec's
terms through `dp_rel`, `dp_initO` and `dp_accO` and `decide_eq_decide`. -/
private theorem dp_fit (N : FinNDTM Bool) {c : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (s w : ℕ) (hsw : s ≤ w)
    {σ : Fin 4 → Fin 5} (j : Fin 5) (La : Language Bool) (hj : dpAs N j = La) (h1 : σ 1 = 1)
    (h2 : σ 2 = j) (h3 : σ 3 = 3) {ι : Lb 0 → DpLb c} {k : Bool → DpLb c}
    (hD : ∀ l, dpD c (ι l) = (A 0 l).embed dpρ σ ι k 24) {B : ℕ} (hBB : 2 ^ (w * w) ≤ B)
    {v' : Fin 25 → ℕ} (he : ∀ r', v' r' ≤ B)
    (hv : ∀ r, v' (dpρ r) = Function.update (Function.update (Function.update
      (Function.update (Function.update (Function.update (fun _ => 0) rs s) rw w) rK (2 ^ w))
        rU 0) rV 0) rM 0 r) :
    ∃ v₂', (∀ r', (∀ r, dpρ r ≠ r') → v₂' r' = v' r') ∧ (∀ r, v₂' (dpρ r) ≤ 2 ^ (w * w)) ∧
      AReach (dpD c) (dpOrc N) x (GuardLe (dpD c) x B) (some (ι .OU), v', none)
        (some (k (decide (∃ u < 2 ^ w, pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits u) (Nat.bits s)) ∈
            initLang N ∧ ∃ v < 2 ^ w, pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits v) (Nat.bits s)) ∈
              La ∧ Reach (2 ^ w) (StepRel N x s) w u v))), v₂', none) := by
  have hR : RegExt dpρ v' _ v' := ⟨hv, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  rw [← setSt_toV, ← outerSt_toV] at hR
  have hrun := outerU_run (E := 0) (orc := dpOrc N ∘ σ) (x := x) hsw (2 ^ w) 0 0
    (by omega) (Nat.zero_le _)
  obtain ⟨v₂', e1, e2, e3⟩ := AHalt.embed_guardLe dpρ_inj hD (A_noVal 0) hBB he hrun hR
  have hiff : (∃ u', 0 ≤ u' ∧ u' < 2 ^ w ∧ InitO (dpOrc N ∘ σ) x s u' ∧
      ∃ v < 2 ^ w, AccO (dpOrc N ∘ σ) x s v ∧
        Reach (2 ^ w) (Rel (dpOrc N ∘ σ) x s) w u' v) ↔
      (∃ u < 2 ^ w, pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits u) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ initLang N ∧
        ∃ v < 2 ^ w, pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits v) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ La ∧
          Reach (2 ^ w) (StepRel N x s) w u v) := by
    rw [dp_rel N σ h3, ← hj]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, -, hu, hi, v, hv, he, hr⟩
      exact ⟨u, hu, (dp_initO N σ h1 x s u).mp hi, v, hv, (dp_accO N σ j h2 x s v).mp he, hr⟩
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, hi, v, hv, he, hr⟩
      exact ⟨u, Nat.zero_le _, hu, (dp_initO N σ h1 x s u).mpr hi, v, hv,
        (dp_accO N σ j h2 x s v).mpr he, hr⟩
  rw [decide_eq_decide.mpr hiff] at e3
  exact ⟨v₂', e1, e2, e3⟩

/-! ## The deepening loop -/

section Loop

variable {c : ℕ} {B : ℕ}

open Classical in
/-- **A block at radius `s`**: from `cb f 0`, `D` prepares block `f` (`dp_prep`) and runs it
(`dp_fit`) to its exit `k b`, where `b` is the block's answer at radius `s` and width
`w = c · (s + ℓ + 1)`; `ℓ`, `s` and the scratch register are unchanged.

**Proof sketch.** `dp_prep` reaches the block's entry with the entry registers; `dp_fit` runs
the block; `D`'s own registers are off `ρ`'s range, so the block leaves them (`dpρ_ne`), and
every register stays at most `B` (`dp_bd_blk`). -/
private theorem dp_block (N : FinNDTM Bool) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (x : List Bool) {s ℓ : ℕ}
    (hBB : 2 ^ (c * (s + ℓ + 1) * (c * (s + ℓ + 1))) ≤ B) (f : Bool) {σ : Fin 4 → Fin 5}
    (j : Fin 5) (La : Language Bool) (hj : dpAs N j = La) (h1 : σ 1 = 1) (h2 : σ 2 = j)
    (h3 : σ 3 = 3) {ι : Lb 0 → DpLb c} {k : Bool → DpLb c}
    (hD : ∀ l, dpD c (ι l) = (A 0 l).embed dpρ σ ι k 24) (hι : dpIn (c := c) f = ι .OU)
    {v : Fin 25 → ℕ} (hL : v 22 = ℓ) (hS : v 23 = s) (hZ : v 24 = 0) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) :
    ∃ v₂, AReach (dpD c) (dpOrc N) x (GuardLe (dpD c) x B) (some (.cb f 0), v, none)
        (some (k (decide (∃ u < 2 ^ (c * (s + ℓ + 1)),
          pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits u) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ initLang N ∧
          ∃ v < 2 ^ (c * (s + ℓ + 1)), pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits v) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ La ∧
            Reach (2 ^ (c * (s + ℓ + 1))) (StepRel N x s) (c * (s + ℓ + 1)) u v))), v₂, none) ∧
      v₂ 22 = ℓ ∧ v₂ 23 = s ∧ v₂ 24 = 0 ∧ ∀ r, v₂ r ≤ B := by
  have hsw : s ≤ c * (s + ℓ + 1) := le_mul_of_one_le_of_le hc (by omega)
  have hB : 2 ^ (c * (s + ℓ + 1)) ≤ B := (size_facts _).2.trans hBB
  obtain ⟨v', r1, e1, e2, e3, e4, e5⟩ := dp_prep (o := dpOrc N) (x := x) hc f hB hL hS hZ hv
  obtain ⟨v₂, f1, f2, r2⟩ := dp_fit N x s _ hsw j La hj h1 h2 h3 hD hBB e5 e1
  rw [hι] at r1
  exact ⟨v₂, r1.trans r2, (f1 22 fun r => dpρ_ne r (by decide)).trans e2,
    (f1 23 fun r => dpρ_ne r (by decide)).trans e3, (f1 24 fun r => dpρ_ne r (by decide)).trans e4,
    dp_bd_blk f1 f2 hBB e5⟩

open Classical in
/-- **The edge step** at radius `s`: `D` prepares and runs the edge block, which exits through
`dpkE b` with `b = false` exactly when no edge code is reachable (`NoEdge`). -/
private theorem dp_edge (N : FinNDTM Bool) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (x : List Bool) {s ℓ : ℕ}
    (hBB : 2 ^ (c * (s + ℓ + 1) * (c * (s + ℓ + 1))) ≤ B) {v : Fin 25 → ℕ} (hL : v 22 = ℓ)
    (hS : v 23 = s) (hZ : v 24 = 0) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) :
    ∃ b v₂, AReach (dpD c) (dpOrc N) x (GuardLe (dpD c) x B) (some (.cb false 0), v, none)
        (some (dpkE b), v₂, none) ∧ (b = false ↔ NoEdge N x s (c * (s + ℓ + 1))) ∧
      v₂ 22 = ℓ ∧ v₂ 23 = s ∧ v₂ 24 = 0 ∧ ∀ r, v₂ r ≤ B := by
  obtain ⟨v₂, r, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩ := dp_block N hc x hBB false 4 (edgeLang N) rfl (σ := dpσE) rfl
    rfl rfl (ι := DpLb.eb) (k := dpkE) (fun _ => rfl) rfl hL hS hZ hv
  exact ⟨_, v₂, r, by rw [decide_eq_false_iff_not, noEdge_iff], e1, e2, e3, e4⟩

open Classical in
/-- **The accept step** at radius `s`, when no edge code is reachable: `D` prepares and runs
the accept block, whose exit bit is membership (`mem_iff_reach_of_noEdge`), and answers it. -/
private theorem dp_acc (N : FinNDTM Bool) {L : Language Bool} {sp : ℕ → ℕ}
    (h : N.DecidesInSpace L sp) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (x : List Bool) {s ℓ : ℕ}
    (hBB : 2 ^ (c * (s + ℓ + 1) * (c * (s + ℓ + 1))) ≤ B)
    (hw : codeK N * (s + logSpace x.length + 1) ≤ c * (s + ℓ + 1))
    (hne : NoEdge N x s (c * (s + ℓ + 1))) {v : Fin 25 → ℕ} (hL : v 22 = ℓ)
    (hS : v 23 = s) (hZ : v 24 = 0) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) :
    AHalt (dpD c) (dpOrc N) x (GuardLe (dpD c) x B) (some (.cb true 0), v, none)
      (decide (x ∈ L)) := by
  obtain ⟨v₂, r, -, -, -, e4⟩ := dp_block N hc x hBB true 2 (acceptLang N) rfl (σ := dpσA) rfl
    rfl rfl (ι := DpLb.ab) (k := DpLb.fin) (fun _ => rfl) rfl hL hS hZ hv
  rw [(@decide_eq_decide _ _ _ (Classical.propDecidable _)).mpr
    (mem_iff_reach_of_noEdge h x s _ hw hne).symm] at r
  exact r.halt (AHalt.ret rfl ⟨dp_pre (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩)), e4⟩)

end Loop

/-- The largest code width of the run on `x`, at radius `sp |x| + 1`. -/
private def dpW (N : FinNDTM Bool) (sp : ℕ → ℕ) (x : List Bool) : ℕ :=
  (codeK N + 1) * (sp x.length + 1 + (1 + (Nat.bits x.length).length) + 1)

open Classical in
/-- **The deepening loop**: from the body at any radius `1 ≤ s ≤ sp |x| + 1`, `D` answers
`x ∈ L`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `sp |x| + 1 - s`. The edge step (`dp_edge`) exits with `false`
exactly when no edge code is reachable; then the accept step (`dp_acc`) answers membership.
At `s = sp |x| + 1` the bit is `false` (`noEdge_of_lt`). Below, a `true` bit forces
`s ≤ sp |x|` (again `noEdge_of_lt`), and `D` increments `s` and repeats the body. The widths
are at most `dpW N sp x`, so every register stays at most `2 ^ (dpW · dpW)`. -/
private theorem dp_body {N : FinNDTM Bool} {L : Language Bool} {sp : ℕ → ℕ}
    (h : N.DecidesInSpace L sp) (x : List Bool) :
    ∀ k s (v : Fin 25 → ℕ), sp x.length + 1 - s = k → 1 ≤ s → s ≤ sp x.length + 1 →
      v 22 = 1 + (Nat.bits x.length).length → v 23 = s → v 24 = 0 →
      (∀ r, v r ≤ 2 ^ (dpW N sp x * dpW N sp x)) →
      AHalt (dpD (codeK N + 1)) (dpOrc N) x
        (GuardLe (dpD (codeK N + 1)) x (2 ^ (dpW N sp x * dpW N sp x)))
        (some (.cb false 0), v, none) (decide (x ∈ L)) := by
  have hc : 1 ≤ codeK N + 1 := by omega
  have hl := dp_bits_logSpace x.length
  have hWs : ∀ s, s ≤ sp x.length + 1 →
      (codeK N + 1) * (s + (1 + (Nat.bits x.length).length) + 1) ≤ dpW N sp x := fun s hs =>
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
  have hBB : ∀ s, s ≤ sp x.length + 1 →
      2 ^ ((codeK N + 1) * (s + (1 + (Nat.bits x.length).length) + 1) *
        ((codeK N + 1) * (s + (1 + (Nat.bits x.length).length) + 1))) ≤ 2 ^ (dpW N sp x * dpW N sp x) :=
    fun s hs => Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.mul_self_le_mul_self (hWs s hs))
  have hw : ∀ s, codeK N * (s + logSpace x.length + 1) ≤
      (codeK N + 1) * (s + (1 + (Nat.bits x.length).length) + 1) := fun s =>
    Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro s v hk hs1 hs2 hL hS hZ hv
    obtain ⟨b, v₂, r, hb, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩ := dp_edge N hc x (hBB s hs2) hL hS hZ hv
    obtain rfl : b = false := hb.mpr (noEdge_of_lt h x s _ (by omega))
    exact r.halt (dp_acc N h hc x (hBB s hs2) (hw s) (hb.mp rfl) e1 e2 e3 e4)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro s v hk hs1 hs2 hL hS hZ hv
    obtain ⟨b, v₂, r, hb, e1, e2, e3, e4⟩ := dp_edge N hc x (hBB s hs2) hL hS hZ hv
    cases b with
    | false => exact r.halt (dp_acc N h hc x (hBB s hs2) (hw s) (hb.mp rfl) e1 e2 e3 e4)
    | true =>
      have hs : s ≤ sp x.length := by
        by_contra hlt
        exact Bool.noConfusion (hb.mpr (noEdge_of_lt h x s _ (by omega)))
      have hsB : s + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (dpW N sp x * dpW N sp x) := by
        have h1 := hWs (s + 1) (by omega)
        have h2 : dpW N sp x < 2 ^ dpW N sp x := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
        have h3 : 2 ^ dpW N sp x ≤ 2 ^ (dpW N sp x * dpW N sp x) := (size_facts _).2
        have h4 : s + 1 ≤ (codeK N + 1) * (s + 1 + (1 + (Nat.bits x.length).length) + 1) :=
          le_mul_of_one_le_of_le hc (by omega)
        omega
      refine r.halt (AHalt.step ⟨dp_pre (Or.inl ⟨23, .cb false 0, rfl⟩), e4⟩ ?_)
      rw [astep_inc (show dpD (codeK N + 1) (dpkE true) = .inc 23 (.cb false 0) from rfl)]
      exact ih (s + 1) _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
        (by rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]; exact e1)
        (by rw [Function.update_self, e2]) (by rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide)]; exact e3)
        (register_update_le _ _ _ _ e4 (by rw [e2]; exact hsB))

open Classical in
/-- **`D`'s run**: from `scan` with all registers clear, `D` answers `x ∈ L` through register
values at most `2 ^ (dpW · dpW)`.

**Proof sketch.** Count `N := |x|` (`inputLength_loop`, decider `0`), set `ℓ := 1` and halve
`N` to `0` (`Complexity.Codec.halvCount_loop`), so `ℓ = 1 + |bits |x||`; set `s := 1` and run
the deepening loop (`dp_body`). Before the loop every value is at most
`max |x| (1 + |bits |x||)`, below `2 ^ dpW`; the loop keeps every value at most
`2 ^ (dpW · dpW)`. -/
private theorem dp_run {N : FinNDTM Bool} {L : Language Bool} {sp : ℕ → ℕ}
    (h : N.DecidesInSpace L sp) (x : List Bool) :
    AHalt (dpD (codeK N + 1)) (dpOrc N) x
      (GuardLe (dpD (codeK N + 1)) x (2 ^ (dpW N sp x * dpW N sp x)))
      (some .scan, fun _ => 0, none) (decide (x ∈ L)) := by
  have hl := dp_bits_logSpace x.length
  have hW1 : 1 + (Nat.bits x.length).length ≤ dpW N sp x :=
    le_mul_of_one_le_of_le (by omega : 1 ≤ codeK N + 1) (by omega)
  have hWB : 2 ^ dpW N sp x ≤ 2 ^ (dpW N sp x * dpW N sp x) := (size_facts _).2
  have hn : x.length < 2 ^ dpW N sp x :=
    (lt_two_pow_bits _).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega))
  have hWlt : dpW N sp x < 2 ^ dpW N sp x := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  set B := 2 ^ (dpW N sp x * dpW N sp x) with hB
  have hnB : x.length ≤ B := by omega
  have hlB : 1 + (Nat.bits x.length).length ≤ B := by omega
  have r1 := inputLength_loop (dpD (codeK N + 1)) (dpOrc N) x 21 0 .scan .incN .lInc rfl rfl
    (fun m _ => indicator_inputLenLang x m) B hnB (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => Nat.zero_le _)
    (Nat.zero_le _)
  have b1 : ∀ r, Function.update (fun _ : Fin 25 => 0) 21 x.length r ≤ B :=
    register_update_le _ _ _ _ (fun _ => Nat.zero_le _) hnB
  refine (r1.mono fun _ h => h).halt ((dp_inc (l := .lInc) rfl b1).halt ?_)
  rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), zero_add]
  have b2 := register_update_le _ 22 _ _ b1 (show 1 ≤ B by omega)
  have e21 : Function.update (Function.update (fun _ : Fin 25 => 0) 21 x.length) 22 1 21 =
      x.length := by
    rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_self]
  refine (Codec.halvCount_loop (dpD (codeK N + 1)) (dpOrc N) x 21 22 (by decide) .hz .hh .hi .sOne
    rfl rfl rfl B _ b2 (by rw [Function.update_self, e21]; omega)).halt ?_
  rw [Function.update_self, e21]
  have b3 := register_update_le _ 22 _ _ (register_update_le _ 21 _ _ b2 (Nat.zero_le _)) hlB
  refine (dp_inc (l := .sOne) rfl b3).halt ?_
  rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_of_ne (by decide),
    Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_of_ne (by decide), zero_add]
  exact dp_body h x _ 1 _ rfl le_rfl (by omega)
    (by rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_self])
    (Function.update_self _ _ _)
    (by rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_of_ne (by decide),
      Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_of_ne (by decide),
      Function.update_of_ne (by decide)])
    (register_update_le _ _ _ _ b3 (by omega))

/-! ## The contract -/

/-- **The deepening machine meets the contract**: if `N` decides `L` in space `sp`, a register
machine with five logspace deciders decides `L` with every register of at most
`C · (sp |x| + logSpace |x| + 1)²` binary digits. The deciders are `inputLenLang`,
`initLang N`, `acceptLang N`, `stepLang N` and `edgeLang N`, and `C = 9 (codeK N + 1)² + 2`.
The machine never computes `sp`: it searches at radius `s = 1, 2, …` until no configuration
reaches the window's edge ([Sip13, §8.1, proof of Theorem 8.5]; [AB09, Theorem 4.14]).

**Proof sketch.** `D`'s run (`dp_run`) answers `x ∈ L` with every register at most
`2 ^ (W · W)`, `W = (codeK N + 1)(sp |x| + ℓ + 2)` and `ℓ ≤ logSpace |x| + 1`
(`dp_bits_logSpace`). A value `v ≤ 2 ^ (W · W)` has `|bits (v + 1)| ≤ W · W + 2`
(`Complexity.LogProg.length_bits_succ_le`), and `W ≤ 3 (codeK N + 1) X` with
`X = sp |x| + logSpace |x| + 1 ≥ 1`, so `W · W + 2 ≤ (9 (codeK N + 1)² + 2) X²`. -/
theorem deepen_contract {N : FinNDTM Bool} {L : Language Bool} {sp : ℕ → ℕ}
    (h : N.DecidesInSpace L sp) : DeepenContract L sp := by
  refine ⟨25, 5, DpLb (codeK N + 1), inferInstance, inferInstance, dpD (codeK N + 1), .scan,
    dpAs N, fun j => ?_, 9 * (codeK N + 1) ^ 2 + 2, fun x => ?_⟩
  · fin_cases j
    exacts [inputLenLang_mem, initLang_mem, acceptLang_mem, stepLang_mem, edgeLang_mem]
  · rw [indicator_eq_decide]
    refine (dp_run h x).mono fun a ha => ⟨ha.1, fun r => ?_⟩
    have hl := (dp_bits_logSpace x.length).2
    have hls : 1 ≤ logSpace x.length := by rw [logSpace_eq]; omega
    set X := sp x.length + logSpace x.length + 1 with hX
    set W := dpW N sp x with hW
    have hW3 : W ≤ 3 * (codeK N + 1) * X := by
      rw [hW, dpW, mul_comm 3, mul_assoc]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
    refine (length_bits_succ_le ((ha.2 r).trans (Nat.le_succ _))).trans ?_
    have h1 : W * W ≤ 3 * (codeK N + 1) * X * (3 * (codeK N + 1) * X) :=
      Nat.mul_self_le_mul_self hW3
    have h2 : 1 ≤ X * X := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity)
    calc W * W + 2 ≤ 3 * (codeK N + 1) * X * (3 * (codeK N + 1) * X) + 2 * (X * X) := by omega
      _ = (9 * (codeK N + 1) ^ 2 + 2) * X ^ 2 := by ring

end Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM
```

/-!
# Complexity — Turing machines

The multi-tape Turing machine model underlying the Arora-Barak formalization
(see `AroraBarakChapter1Plan.md`): a machine-free configuration/action layer, the
deterministic machine with time and space semantics, the bundled finite layer over which
all complexity classes are stated, and oracle machines as a wrapper over the same
configurations.

The core model files are vendored from cslib
(https://github.com/leanprover/cslib, commit a3747758, 2026-09-14); see the file headers
for the local modifications.

## Contents

* `CodeFormat` — shared transition-record and table-format parsers, with the one-tape instance.
* `Codes2Tape` — the deterministic two-work-tape code scheme (§13, Z3), an instance of
  `CodeFormat`, with its uniform scheme from `CodeSimulator`.

* `Configuration` — configurations `Cfg`, actions `Action` and their application; the
  space measure. Nothing here mentions a machine (vendored).
* `Deterministic` — `MultiTapeTM`, the step/run semantics, time and space bounds
  (vendored).
* `StateRenaming` — transport of actions, configurations, and machines along maps
  of the state type; shared by the oracle embedding and the code normal form.
* `CfgFacts` — four elementary configuration facts: the input read depends on the input head
  only, a redirected live configuration is a phase's tagged configuration, a tagged configuration
  is at no other phase's state, and equal-length chunks have the expected total length.
* `Finite` — the bundled `FinTM` layer carrying `Fintype`/`DecidableEq` state instances;
  all headline definitions are stated over it.
* `Nondeterministic` — binary-choice nondeterministic machines [AB09, §2.1.2]:
  choice-word run semantics, all-branch halting, the bundled `FinNDTM` layer, the
  deterministic embedding, and the run-level transfer, slice, relabelling and input-locality
  lemmas (the classes live in `ClassNP/NTIME`).
* `NondeterministicSpace` — the space measure of binary-choice NDTMs along choice-word
  runs: visited cells, as for the deterministic `SPACE` [AB09, Definition 4.1].
* `ChoiceReplay` — choice-tape determinization: the replay machine of an NDTM, which reads its
  choices from an extra work tape, and the replay lemma [AB09, §2.1.2, Theorem 2.6]. Proved.
* `Oracle` — oracle machines `OracleTM` [AB09, §3.4]: same configurations, oracle-dependent
  step; the embedding of plain machines and its oracle-independence sanity theorems.
* `OracleFinite` — the bundled finite layer `FinOracleTM`, carrying well-formedness as a
  field, over which the oracle classes are stated [AB09, Definition 3.5].
* `OracleNondeterministic` — nondeterministic oracle machines [AB09, Definition 3.4], for
  `NPOracle` and the relativization theorem.
* `OracleAgreement` — oracle locality: runs under oracles agreeing on every submitted
  string coincide [AB09, Theorem 3.7].
* `NDCodes` — codes for nondeterministic machines [AB09, §1.4, §3.2]: the two-work-tape
  coded normal form, its fixed serialization, and the scheme laws with the effective
  (canonizer) form.
* `NDCodeSimulator` — the interpreter core for nondeterministic codes (C1): the serialization
  bridge, the per-code replay canonizer and the core `R` [AB09, Exercise 2.6]. The core is
  proved; the canonizer is sorried.
* `Simulation` — generic machine-construction gadgets: emission chains, control
  actions, disjoint tape-block embeddings with lockstep run lemmas, the input-head
  rewind, and the two-machine branch union.
* `BufferWords` — the cells of a buffer tape holding a composite word: a suffix at an offset, a
  middle word's letters, prefixes and suffixes, the blank cells off the word, and a unary word
  with its terminator. Proved.
* `Sweep` — the generic zipper/transduction layer for sweep-based tape
  simulations, with the initialized-run head/support bound.
* `Composition` — identity/constant machines and closure of time-bounded computability
  under composition; also the formal home of the append-only-output convention
  argument.
* `UnaryTape` — work tapes holding a number in unary.
* `CounterProg`, `CounterProgRun` — counter programs (goto programs over unary registers)
  compiled into machines, with Hoare-style run lemmas; the model of the polynomial-time
  emitters of [AB09, Remark 6.7] (polynomial time: `ClassNP/CounterProgPolyTime`).
* `Build/Embed`, `Build/Seam`, `Build/Catalog` — the §12 routine layer
  (`machine-library-design.md` §12, gate closed round 3): the bank-embedding
  transformers with their returning flavors, seam composition with the
  general-configuration forms and the release adapter, and the space-annotated
  catalog rows.
* `Build/NDHost` — the nondeterministic phase host over NDTM phases and the choice writer, for
  the guess-first route of the nondeterministic time hierarchy (C1). Proved, the writer's
  bounded contract included (C1-W, 2026-10-17).
* `Build/VirtualInput` — virtual-input hosting (`machine-library-design.md` §13, Z1): a
  machine whose input is a buffered work-tape word runs inside a host, one step per step.
* `Build/Zone` — the pure zone layer (§13, Z2, as revised by §13d): zone contents, the
  guarded pairwise ops, the cascade and its mirror, the scanned index, the total rebalance,
  the extension by one level, and the virtual tape a track represents.
* `Build/ZoneTape` — the multi-track zoned carrier over `ZoneSym k` (§13d, G3): the layout
  with blank separators, the inner-packed encoding `zonedTape` and its invariants.
* `Build/ZoneRebalance` — the rebalance and extension rows (§13d, G4), as contracts.
  Proved.
* `Build/ZoneStep` — one track's step from the rows, as a contract, and the amortized
  `O(T log T)` cost of a run ([AB09, §1.7]). Proved.
* `Build/OracleCall` — the oracle-machine rows (`machine-library-design.md` §12.9):
  W1 capture onto the query tape, landing in `qQuery`, and the two-step answer tail.
* `SymbolLift` — the embedding transport (`machine-library-design.md` §12.8, R8.0): a
  `Bool` machine run on a richer alphabet along `e : Bool ↪ Γ`, with time and space
  unchanged.
* `Build/CounterLoop` — the counter-driven loop (§12.7) and the pattern expansion
  `expandTM` (§12.8, R8.6).
* `Build/InputWindow` — the counter-driven copy of a bounded window of the native input onto a
  work tape, for the nondeterministic time hierarchy [AB09, Theorem 3.2]. Proved.
* `Build/SeamLayout` — the step block's table and summary tapes from a captured serialization,
  the one redistribution the step-block startups cite. Proved.
* `Build/Rewind` — the rewind of a work-tape head to the start of a word, from any cell of the
  word or just past it, the empty word included. Proved.
* `Build/InputRewind` — the rewind of the native input head to the first input cell: its exact
  time, its first arrival at the park, and its unchanged work tapes, heads and output; and the
  composition of two state relabelings of a configuration. Proved.
* `Build/InterpreterStartup` — the pieces of a universal machine's startup on a timed paired
  input: the header projections and their capture, the suffix window, the released install call,
  the table-and-summary layout, the seam step, a fresh capture's start. Proved.
* `Build/Scan`, `Build/InputCall`, `Build/CfgRecord` — the §12.8 rows, with the field
  layout, compare, seeks and two-pass scan in `Build/Catalog`'s Part 3: the constant and
  advancing writers and the native-input copy and fold; the input call and input seek;
  the rich configuration-record carrier and the record rows. All proved (§12.8 fill gate
  closed).
* `Build/InputLength`, `Build/RecordTable` — the deferred §12.8 rows (`machine-library-design.md`
  §12.8b): the input length `Nat.bits |x|` (R8.5c), and the table layer over records (header,
  sentinels, find, append, template, init, validity, odometer next, the end-to-start adapter).
  Fills in progress; each module's header carries its status.
* `Build/OracleSim`, `Build/CertShell` — oracle-call simulation (§12.10, the B1b extension): one
  plain host simulating an oracle machine with queries answered by a plain decider, the
  choice-word machine of an oracle NDTM, and the plain certificate shell. Fills in progress;
  each module's header carries its status.
* `Build/StepBlock` — the step block (host H2, `machine-library-design.md` §14): one finite
  machine per work-tape count `k` that performs one simulated transition of a `k`-tape
  binary table held as data, with its contract `Turing.StepBlock.roundTM_effect`, the
  record skipper and fixed-field reader, the per-round space ledger and the cofinal
  iteration. Proved; promoted from `CodeSimulator` (H2-S gate closed, round 2).
* `Build/StepBlockLoop` — the step block's counter loop (host H2's loop form, H2-L,
  `machine-library-design.md` §14): the binary deadline clock over the step block, native and on
  a buffered input, from any represented live start, with its early-escape bound and live
  exits. Proved; harvested from `CodeSimulator` (H1 harvest gate passed, 2026-10-14).
* `Build/StepBlockForward` — the step block's forwarding round loop (host H2's unclocked loop form,
  H2-F, `machine-library-design.md` §14): any `k`-tape table simulated in macro-step lockstep with
  its emissions forwarded, per-step cost bounded by the table's length, and a space ledger.
  Statement gate passed 2026-10-15; the contract is sorried.
* `Build/UniversalParts` — the parts of the `k`-generic universal machines [AB09, §1.4.1,
  Theorem 1.9]: the startup–loop seam with its run and space ledger from any seam endpoint, the
  forwarding loop's readings at an initial configuration, the header ruler (a doubled-header scan
  that extends a ruler, then the rewind) and the suffix-ruler layout. Proved; harvested from
  `UniversalK` (the U2 harvest, 2026-11-06).
* `CodeSimulator` — the format-parameterized uniform simulator over item 8's code formats
  (B5a): one bounded-acceptance interpreter and canonizer whose one- and two-tape instances are
  the EXPCOM and Codes2Tape code schemes. Fills in progress; the module header carries its
  status.
* `ChoiceWords` — certificate and choice words: split uniqueness for length-determined
  suffixes, the exact NP certificate length's monotonicity, the choice budget, and the
  truncation of halted branch runs. Shared by the plain Theorem 2.6, the oracle simulation's
  choice-word law and the certificate shell (wave-1 statement gate, round 1).
* `CounterProgInput` — transport a counter-program run past an input prefix
  that has already been consumed.
* `Build/Contract` — the framed-contract library (MIG-0a and MIG-0b, `machine-library-design.md`
  §16a), the facade of `Build/Contract/{Basic,Seam,Embed,Catalog,Lift}`: exact time, an endpoint
  function, an exit set with a no-earlier-exit cut and head envelopes, a derived frames layer,
  the compositions `trans`, `seq`, `inPhase`, `embed`, `branch` and the releases as thin
  wrappers over the public rows, and the segment, round and joint-trajectory layers with state
  renaming and the macro-step lockstep. The core, `Build/Contract/Basic`, imports only the
  machine core. Proved; the MIG-0a and MIG-0b gates closed.
* `Build/NDCombinators`, `Build/NDClockHost`, `Build/NDClockHostRun` — the nondeterministic
  construction rows: run locality, output maps and the coin dispatcher for binary-choice
  machines, and the clocked restart host `Turing.FinNDTM.clockHost` (clocked runner and
  restart loop of [AB09, §7.4.2, Exercise 7.6(a)]) with its startup and round contracts.
* `Build/StepClock`, `Build/WindowRun` — host H3 (`machine-library-design.md` §14): the
  step-clocked runner, shared with the nondeterministic time hierarchy; the semantic windowed
  run `windowRun`; the windowed round loop and the step-clocked windowed runner. Statement gate
  passed 2026-10-14; the specification is proved, the machine contracts are sorried.
* `Build/InputDevice` — host H5: the input-device interface, the native device, and the
  bounded-prefix ruler device with its boundary test, call rows and host. Proved.
* `Build/Convention`, `Build/Wrappers`, `Build/Loop`, `Build/Primitives` — the
  machine-construction library (`machine-library-design.md`): the `Cfg.ofWords` seam
  discipline, the capture/silence and halt-redirect wrappers with the timed branch,
  the bounded-loop combinator, and the primitive catalog of timed string functions.
  Proved, and audited at the shared-infrastructure gates.
* `Build/WordTests` — two linear-time one-bit word tests, equality with a fixed word and the
  all-`true` word, in the form the timed conditional takes as its test. Proved.
* `Robustness/AlphabetReduction` — binary alphabet suffices [AB09, Claim 1.5].
* `Robustness/SingleTape` — one work tape suffices, quadratically [AB09, Claim 1.6].
* `Robustness/TwoTapes` — two work tapes suffice, with logarithmic overhead, run by run
  (Hennie–Stearns; the simulation is stated, and its proof is open).
* `Robustness/Bidirectional` — unidirectional tape use suffices [AB09, Claim 1.8].
* `Robustness/Oblivious` — oblivious machines and the quadratic oblivious simulation
  [AB09, Remark 1.7, Exercise 1.5] (imports the `ClassP` definitions it needs).
* `NatBits` — the elementary bounds on the binary length `|Nat.bits n|` (below `Encoding` and
  `SpaceComplexity/Machines/Bin`; no TCSlib import).
* `Encoding` — machines as strings [AB09, §1.4]: the code normal form `CodeTM`, the
  fixed canonical serialization, the representation-scheme laws `MachineCode`, and
  the effective scheme `EffectiveMachineCode` that the universal machine requires.
* `Universal` — the universal machine [AB09, Theorem 1.9]: the all-string evaluator
  with linear overhead and divergence preservation, the relaxed quadratic
  total-function form, and the time-bounded variant (code-first input layout).
* `UniversalK` — the `k`-generic universal machine (U2) [AB09, Theorem 1.9]: the `k`-tape
  scheme interface `EffectiveCodeK` with the one- and two-tape schemes as instances, the startup,
  the self-application universal machine with time and space ledgers, and the code-first
  evaluator, all proved.
* `UniversalTlogT` — the efficient universal machine [AB09, Theorem 1.9] at `T log T`, per run
  and with the converse, proved from `Robustness/TwoTapes`'s reduction and `UniversalK`.
* `SelfUniversal` — the self-application universal machine `U₀` and its startup
  [AB09, Exercise 4.1], the universal machine of the space hierarchy's window route.
  Both are proved, as the `k = 1` cases of `UniversalK`'s statements.
-/

/-!
# Machine-construction library: catalog promotions and space annotations (R3)

The R3 increment of the machine-construction library
(`machine-library-design.md` §12): the remaining audited A-chain tape
routines promoted as public machines with exact time **and** space costs,
plus the space retro-annotation of the existing catalog and control
surface. Per frozen decision 12.2 this lives in a **new** file — the new
rows and the space lemmas for the old rows both — keeping
`Build/Primitives.lean` byte-identical; the later refactor toward a
per-theme layout is a recorded backlog item.

**Status: proved.** The five routine machines and their two phase
alphabets are real definitions (TM1-style labelled control, the catalog's
house idiom), and every contract is proved: the §12 fill epochs F1/F2
(gates closed 2026-10-09) and the §12.6 framed contracts (fill gate closed
2026-10-10). Part 3 below is also proved: its §12.8 machines are real
definitions, and its contracts share the public catalog trace and action-step lemmas.

## Part 1 — new promotions (seam routines)

Configuration-level routines at the `Turing.Cfg.ofWords` seam of
`TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Convention`, entering at their
start anchor with heads at the origin and exiting at a **live** anchor
(first-return cut included in each contract), so they compose under
`Turing.seamCompTM`. These are D6-style promotions of the audited 4A
privates — the A3 chain proved `3|w| + 3` copy and `2|w| + 2` clear,
matching the external prior art's catalog to within one step
(independent convergence, 2026-10-06 survey; [Bon26], the
transfer/clear/copy routine catalog):

* `Turing.transferTM` — move a word from tape `src` to tape `dst`
  (source erased), within `3|w| + 3`.
* `Turing.copyTM` — copy a word from tape `src` to tape `dst` (source
