import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.UniformSample
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Word
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Constructible
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.Mult
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.QueryReshape
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Bin
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Frag
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.SavitchARM.Deepen
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Catalog
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.CfgRecord
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.InputLength
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.RecordTable
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.NatBits

open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let wanted : List Name := [`TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.Meyer, `TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.MeyerTableau, `TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.ExhaustiveReplay, `TCSlib.Complexity.CookLevin.Hardness, `TCSlib.Complexity.Diagonalization.NTimeDiagonalizer, `TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.QuasiPolyHierarchy, `TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.SpaceAmplifyPoly, `TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.UniformSample, `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Word, `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Constructible, `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.Mult, `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.QueryReshape, `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Bin, `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Frag, `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.SavitchARM.Deepen, `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine, `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Catalog, `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.CfgRecord, `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.InputLength, `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.RecordTable, `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding, `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.NatBits]
  for mod in wanted do
    unless (env.getModuleIdx? mod).isSome do throwError "missing imported module {mod}"
  let names := env.constants.toList.filterMap fun (n, ci) =>
    match env.getModuleIdxFor? n with
    | some i =>
      let mod := env.header.moduleNames[i.toNat]!
      if wanted.contains mod && !isPrivateName n then some (n, ci, mod) else none
    | none => none
  for (n, ci, mod) in names.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a.1.toString < b.1.toString) do
    let kind := match ci with
      | .thmInfo _ => "theorem" | .defnInfo _ => "definition"
      | .opaqueInfo _ => "opaque" | .axiomInfo _ => "axiom"
      | .ctorInfo _ => "constructor" | .recInfo _ => "recursor"
      | .inductInfo _ => "inductive" | .quotInfo _ => "quotient"
    logInfo m!"CONSTANT {n} module={mod} kind={kind} internal={n.isInternalDetail}"

import TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.MeyerSigma
import TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.MeyerSigmaEXP
import TCSlib.Complexity.PolyHierarchy.Collapse
import TCSlib.Complexity.TimeHierarchy.Separation

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Meyer's theorem

[AB09, Thm 6.20] (Meyer): **if `EXP ⊆ P/poly` then `EXP = Σ₂ᵖ`**, and its consequence
[AB09, p. 115]: **if `P = NP` then `EXP ⊄ P/poly`**. The inclusion `Σ₂ᵖ ⊆ EXP` is
unconditional (`Complexity.SigmaP_two_subset_EXP`, `MeyerSigmaEXP.lean`); the content of
the theorem is `EXP ⊆ Σ₂ᵖ`.

## The proof

Let `L ∈ EXP` be decided by `M` within `c₀ · 2^{n^c}` steps. The *tableau language*
`Tab M` (`MeyerTab.lean`) — "the bit selected by `sel` of the configuration of `M` on `x`
after `t` steps, at offset `±a` from a head" — is in `EXP`, decided by the machine
`tabTM M` (`MeyerMachine*.lean`). Under `EXP ⊆ P/poly` it has polynomial-size circuits.
Then

`x ∈ L ⟺ ∃ U ∀ (t, a, j, p) : (t, a, j, p) is not a counterexample for U`,

where `U` pads the description of a circuit guessed to compute the tableau at the query
length of `x`, and the counterexamples (`MeyerVerifier.lean`) are the failures of the
local checks — initial row, step rule, final row — evaluated with the circuit evaluator
`CVAL`. If `x ∈ L`, the true circuit passes all checks (`complete_numeric`); if a guessed
circuit passes all checks, it computes the true tableau row by row, so the true run
accepts (`sound_numeric`). The inner language is in `coNP`, so `L ∈ Σ₂ᵖ`.

## Divergences from [AB09]

* **Head-relative tableau instead of oblivious snapshots.** The book makes `M` oblivious
  and has the verifier compute, for each snapshot index, the indices of the previous
  visits of each head ("these indices can be represented in polynomial time"). That
  computation is exponentially long for the obliviousness construction available here
  (`Complexity.oblivious_of_mem_DTIME`, whose schedule is only existential). Instead the
  guessed tableau records, for every time `t`, each tape's contents *relative to its
  head*; one step changes such a row only locally (cell `d` becomes the old cell `d + m`,
  or the written symbol), so the checks need only increments, unary input indices and
  `CVAL` queries. Work-tape offsets are sound inside a light cone; input offsets range
  over `[-(n+1), n+1]` with an explicit boundary rule.
* **Width.** Times and offsets are words of the explicit width `W = (c₀+3)(n+1)^{c+1}`,
  so `2^W - 1` bounds the running time; the final check is at time `2^W - 1`.
* **`Σ₂ᵖ ⊆ EXP`** (used tacitly by the book) is proved in `MeyerSigmaEXP.lean` through a
  the brute-force enumerator of `ClassNP/EXP.lean` with an arbitrary-time verifier
  (`Complexity.exists_proj_decider`).
* **The time hierarchy** enters through `Complexity.P_ne_EXP`, proved in
  `TimeHierarchy/Separation.lean` with the library's quadratic universal-machine overhead.

## Main definitions

None.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Meyer.width_ok` — the width suffices; `Complexity.Meyer.mem_iff_final` —
  acceptance in the final row; `Complexity.Meyer.desc_len_le` — the guessed description
  has polynomial length.

* `Complexity.EXP_subset_SigmaP_two_of_EXP_subset_PPoly` — the inclusion `EXP ⊆ Σ₂ᵖ`.
* `Complexity.EXP_eq_SigmaP_two_of_EXP_subset_PPoly` — [AB09, Thm 6.20].
* `Complexity.not_EXP_subset_PPoly_of_P_eq_NP` — [AB09, p. 115, corollary of Thm 6.20].

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§3.1, Theorem 3.1; §5.2, Theorem 5.4; §6.4,
  Theorem 6.20, pp. 114–115.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Meyer

open Turing BoolCircuit Complexity.TimeHierarchy Complexity.PolyHierarchy

/-! ### The width -/

/-- `(n + 1)^{c+1} ≥ n^c + n`. -/
theorem pow_succ_ge (n c : ℕ) : n ^ c + n ≤ (n + 1) ^ (c + 1) := by
  have h1 : n ^ c ≤ (n + 1) ^ c := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) c
  have h2 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ c := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  rw [pow_succ]
  nlinarith

/-- **The width suffices**: with `W = (c₀ + 3)(n + 1)^{c+1}`, the last time `2^W - 1`
bounds the running time `c₀ 2^{n^c}`, and input offsets `≤ n + 2` fit in `W` bits.

**Proof sketch.** Since `(n+1)^{c+1} ≥ n^c + n`, `W ≥ c₀ + n^c + n + 2`, so `2^W ≥ 2^{c₀}
2^{n^c} 2^{n+2}`; bound `2^{c₀} ≥ c₀ + 1` and `2^{n+2} > n + 2`. -/
theorem width_ok (c₀ c n : ℕ) :
    n + 2 < 2 ^ wd (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) n ∧ c₀ * 2 ^ n ^ c ≤ 2 ^ wd (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) n - 1 := by
  have hX := pow_succ_ge n c
  have hX1 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (c + 1) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hW : c₀ + n ^ c + (n + 2) ≤ wd (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) n := by
    unfold wd; nlinarith
  have h2 : 2 ^ (c₀ + n ^ c + (n + 2)) ≤ 2 ^ wd (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) n :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hW
  rw [pow_add, pow_add] at h2
  have ha : c₀ + 1 ≤ 2 ^ c₀ := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have hb : n + 2 < 2 ^ (n + 2) := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have hc : 1 ≤ 2 ^ n ^ c := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have hp : 0 < 2 ^ c₀ * 2 ^ n ^ c := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.two_pow_pos _) (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
  constructor
  · calc n + 2 < 2 ^ (n + 2) := hb
      _ ≤ 2 ^ c₀ * 2 ^ n ^ c * 2 ^ (n + 2) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hp
      _ ≤ _ := h2
  · have e1 : (c₀ + 1) * 2 ^ n ^ c * (n + 2) ≤ 2 ^ c₀ * 2 ^ n ^ c * 2 ^ (n + 2) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul ha le_rfl) hb.le
    have e2 : c₀ * 2 ^ n ^ c + 1 ≤ (c₀ + 1) * 2 ^ n ^ c := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul]; omega
    have e3 : (c₀ + 1) * 2 ^ n ^ c ≤ (c₀ + 1) * 2 ^ n ^ c * (n + 2) :=
      Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
    omega

/-- **Acceptance in the final row**: if `M` decides `L` within `c₀ 2^{n^c}` steps, then
`x ∈ L` iff the run is halted with output summary `one true` at time `2^W - 1`. -/
theorem mem_iff_final {L : Language Bool} {M : FinTM Bool} {c₀ c : ℕ}
    (hM : M.DecidesInTime L fun n => c₀ * 2 ^ n ^ c) (x : List Bool) :
    x ∈ L ↔ SS (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) (2 ^ wd (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) x.length - 1)) =
      (none, OutReg.one true) := by
  have h := ((hM x).mono (width_ok c₀ c x.length).2)
  rw [Turing.FinTM.computesInTime_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
  simp only [SS, h1, h2, OutReg.ofList, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.indicator]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ L <;> simp [hx]

/-! ### The guessed description -/

/-- **The guessed description has polynomial length** [AB09, Thm 6.20 proof: "a
`q(n)`-sized circuit `C`"]: the description of a size-`a(n+1)^k` fan-in-two family's
circuit for the query length `nbits + 4W + 4 + n`, plus one marker bit, fits in
`(12 a² K^{2k} + 1)(n + 1)^{2(cw+1)k}` bits, `K = nbits + 4 Cw + 6`.

**Proof sketch.** The query length plus one is at most `K (n + 1)^{cw+1}`; the size bound
and `length_encode_le_of_isFaninTwo` (`|⌜C⌝| ≤ 12 S²`) give the bound. -/
theorem desc_len_le {a k : ℕ} (Cw cw nb : ℕ) {F : DAGCircuitFamily} (hF : F.HasFaninTwo)
    (hS : ∀ n, (F.circuit n).size ≤ a * (n + 1) ^ k) (n : ℕ) :
    (F.circuit (nb + 2 * wd Cw cw n + 2 * wd Cw cw n + 4 + n)).encode.length + 1 ≤
      (12 * a ^ 2 * (nb + 4 * Cw + 6) ^ (2 * k) + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (2 * (cw + 1) * k) := by
  set P := (n + 1) ^ (cw + 1) with hP
  set K := nb + 4 * Cw + 6 with hK
  have hP1 : 1 ≤ P := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hn1 : n + 1 ≤ P := by
    calc n + 1 = (n + 1) ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ P := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  have hWP : wd Cw cw n ≤ Cw * P :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
  have hq : nb + 2 * wd Cw cw n + 2 * wd Cw cw n + 4 + n + 1 ≤ K * P := by
    have : K * P = nb * P + 4 * (Cw * P) + 6 * P := by rw [hK]; ring
    rw [this]
    have : nb ≤ nb * P := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hP1
    omega
  have hsize : (F.circuit (nb + 2 * wd Cw cw n + 2 * wd Cw cw n + 4 + n)).size ≤
      a * K ^ k * P ^ k := by
    calc _ ≤ a * (nb + 2 * wd Cw cw n + 2 * wd Cw cw n + 4 + n + 1) ^ k := hS _
      _ ≤ a * (K * P) ^ k := Nat.mul_le_mul_left a (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hq k)
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow, mul_assoc]
  have henc := DAGCircuit.length_encode_le_of_isFaninTwo _
    (hF (nb + 2 * wd Cw cw n + 2 * wd Cw cw n + 4 + n))
  have hPk : P ^ (2 * k) = (n + 1) ^ (2 * (cw + 1) * k) := by
    rw [hP, ← pow_mul]; ring_nf
  have hone : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (2 * (cw + 1) * k) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hsq := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hsize 2
  calc _ ≤ 12 * (a * K ^ k * P ^ k) ^ 2 + 1 := by omega
    _ = 12 * a ^ 2 * K ^ (2 * k) * (n + 1) ^ (2 * (cw + 1) * k) + 1 := by
        rw [← hPk]; ring
    _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith

/-- The in-range instance of numbers `(t, a, j)` satisfies the range atom.

**Proof sketch.** The words `enumWord W t`, `enumWord W a` have width `W`; the padded code `bits j
++ 0^{W - |bits j|}` has length `W` because `|bits j| = size j ≤ W` for `j < 2^W`. -/
theorem lenAll_inst (M : FinTM Bool) (Cw cw : ℕ) (x U : List Bool) {t a j : ℕ}
    (hj : j ≤ x.length + 1) (hjW : j < 2 ^ wd Cw cw x.length) :
    evalAtom Cw cw M .lenAll (vin x U (enumWord (wd Cw cw x.length) t) (enumWord (wd Cw cw x.length) a)
      (List.replicate j true)
      (List.replicate (wd Cw cw x.length - (Nat.bits j).length) false)) = true := by
  have hb : (Nat.bits j).length ≤ wd Cw cw x.length := by
    rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]; exact Nat.size_le.mpr hjW
  simp only [evalAtom, vt_vin, va_vin, vj_vin, vx_vin, bjw, vp_vin, length_enumWord,
    List.length_replicate, List.length_append, decide_eq_true_eq]
  refine ⟨trivial, trivial, hj, by omega⟩

end Complexity.Meyer

namespace Complexity

open Turing BoolCircuit Meyer Complexity.TimeHierarchy Complexity.PolyHierarchy
  Complexity.KarpLipton

/-- **Meyer's theorem, the main inclusion** [AB09, Thm 6.20, proof]: if `EXP ⊆ P/poly`
then every `EXP` language is in `Σ₂ᵖ`.

Here `P/poly` is `BoolCircuit.PPoly` (polynomial-size fan-in-two families of the book's
circuit model, [AB09, Def 6.5]) and `Σ₂ᵖ` is `Complexity.SigmaP 2` ([AB09, Def 5.3]).
Divergence (see the module docstring): the guessed tableau is head-relative rather than
the book's oblivious snapshots.

**Proof sketch.** Let `M` decide `L` within `c₀ 2^{n^c}`; its tableau language is in
`EXP` (`Tab_mem_EXP`), hence decided by a polynomial-size fan-in-two family `F`. Then
`x ∈ L ⟺ ∃ U (|U| = B(|x|+1)^b), ⟨x, U⟩ ∈ innerLang`, a `Σ₂ᵖ` formula since
`innerLang ∈ coNP`: (⇒) pad the description of `F`'s circuit for the query length of `x`
(`desc_len_le`); on every in-range instance the atoms are the numeric valuation of
`F`'s truthful answers (`atoms_vin`, `ansD_family`), which pass every check
(`complete_numeric`) because `M` accepts by time `2^W - 1` (`mem_iff_final`); (⇐) the
in-range instances give the hypothesis of `sound_numeric`, so the true run accepts. -/
theorem EXP_subset_SigmaP_two_of_EXP_subset_PPoly (h : EXP ⊆ BoolCircuit.PPoly) :
    EXP ⊆ SigmaP 2 := by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨c, c₀, M, hM⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hL
  obtain ⟨a, k, F, hF, hS, hFL⟩ := h (Tab_mem_EXP M)
  refine mem_SigmaP_two_iff.mpr ⟨12 * a ^ 2 * (nbits M + 4 * (c₀ + 3) + 6) ^ (2 * k) + 1,
    2 * (c + 1 + 1) * k, innerLang (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) M, innerLang_mem_coNP _ _ M, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hn := (width_ok c₀ c x.length).1
  have hfin := mem_iff_final hM x
  constructor
  · -- completeness: the true circuit passes every check
    intro hx
    have hacc := hfin.mp hx
    set W := wd (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) x.length with hW
    set d := (F.circuit (nbits M + 2 * W + 2 * W + 4 + x.length)).encode with hd
    have hlen := desc_len_le (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) (nbits M) hF hS x.length
    rw [← hW, ← hd] at hlen
    refine ⟨List.replicate ((12 * a ^ 2 * (nbits M + 4 * (c₀ + 3) + 6) ^ (2 * k) + 1) *
        (x.length + 1) ^ (2 * (c + 1 + 1) * k) - d.length - 1) true ++ false :: d, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons]
      omega
    · intro v hv
      set U := List.replicate ((12 * a ^ 2 * (nbits M + 4 * (c₀ + 3) + 6) ^ (2 * k) + 1) *
        (x.length + 1) ^ (2 * (c + 1 + 1) * k) - d.length - 1) true ++ false :: d with hU
      have hDU : dropMarker U = d := by rw [hU, dropMarker_marker]
      set z := pairEncode (pairEncode x U) v with hz
      have hcong : (fun α => evalAtom (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) M α z) =
          fun α => evalAtom (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) M α (vin x U (vt z) (va z) (vj z) (vp z)) := by
        funext α
        apply evalAtom_congr <;> simp [vx, vD, vt, va, vj, vp, z, vin]
      change badF M (fun α => evalAtom (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) M α z) = true at hv
      rw [hcong] at hv
      simp only [badF, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true', decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hv
      obtain ⟨hlenA, hnot⟩ := hv
      have hat := atoms_vin (M := M) (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) x U (vt z) (va z) (vj z) (vp z) hn hlenA
      rw [hat] at hnot
      apply hnot
      have hrange := hlenA
      simp only [evalAtom, vt_vin, va_vin, vj_vin, vx_vin, decide_eq_true_eq] at hrange
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩ := hrange
      have hT : ∀ sel t a, t < 2 ^ W → a < 2 ^ W →
          AnsOf M W x (dropMarker U) sel t a =
            tabAns M sel (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t) a := by
        intro sel t a ht ha
        rw [hDU, hd]
        exact ansD_family hF hFL W x sel t a ht ha
      have hgood := complete_numeric (M := M) (Ans := AnsOf M W x (dropMarker U)) (W := W)
        (x := x) hT (xb := xbOf x) (fun j hj => xbOf_eq x j hj) hn hacc
      exact hgood _ _ _ (by have := ctrVal_lt (vt z); rwa [h1] at this)
        (by have := ctrVal_lt (va z); rwa [h2] at this) h3
  · -- soundness: a description passing every check certifies acceptance
    rintro ⟨U, -, hU⟩
    apply hfin.mpr
    set W := wd (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) x.length with hW
    refine sound_numeric (Ans := AnsOf M W x (dropMarker U)) (xb := xbOf x) ?_
      (fun j hj => xbOf_eq x j hj)
    intro t a j ht ha hj
    have hjW : j < 2 ^ W := by omega
    have hz := hU (pairEncode (pairEncode (enumWord W t) (enumWord W a))
      (pairEncode (List.replicate j true) (List.replicate (W - (Nat.bits j).length) false)))
    have hlenA := lenAll_inst M (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) x U (t := t) (a := a) hj hjW
    have hat := atoms_vin (M := M) (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) x U _ _ _ _ hn hlenA
    simp only [← hW] at hat
    simp only [List.length_replicate, ctrVal_enumWord W t ht, ctrVal_enumWord W a ha] at hat
    change ¬ (badF M (fun α => evalAtom (c₀ + 3) (c + 1) M α (vin x U _ _ _ _)) = true) at hz
    rw [hat] at hz
    simp only [badF, NumVal, Bool.true_and, Bool.not_eq_true', decide_eq_false_iff_not,
      not_not] at hz
    exact hz

/-- **Meyer's theorem** [AB09, Thm 6.20]: if `EXP ⊆ P/poly` then `EXP = Σ₂ᵖ`.

**Proof sketch.** `EXP ⊆ Σ₂ᵖ` is `EXP_subset_SigmaP_two_of_EXP_subset_PPoly`; the converse
`Σ₂ᵖ ⊆ EXP` holds unconditionally (`SigmaP_two_subset_EXP`). -/
theorem EXP_eq_SigmaP_two_of_EXP_subset_PPoly (h : EXP ⊆ BoolCircuit.PPoly) :
    EXP = SigmaP 2 :=
  Set.Subset.antisymm (EXP_subset_SigmaP_two_of_EXP_subset_PPoly h) SigmaP_two_subset_EXP

/-- **`P = NP` implies `EXP ⊄ P/poly`** [AB09, p. 115, after Thm 6.20]: "if `P = NP`, then
`P = Σ₂ᵖ` (Thm 5.4), and so if `EXP ⊆ P/poly` we'd get `P = EXP`, contradicting the Time
Hierarchy Theorem (Thm 3.1)."

**Proof sketch.** Under `EXP ⊆ P/poly`, Meyer's theorem gives `EXP ⊆ Σ₂ᵖ ⊆ PH`, and
`P = NP` collapses `PH = P` (`Complexity.PH_eq_P_of_P_eq_NP`), so `EXP ⊆ P ⊆ EXP`,
contradicting `Complexity.P_ne_EXP`. -/
theorem not_EXP_subset_PPoly_of_P_eq_NP (h : P = NP) : ¬ EXP ⊆ BoolCircuit.PPoly := by
  intro hE
  have h1 : EXP ⊆ P := by
    rw [← PH_eq_P_of_P_eq_NP h]
    exact (EXP_subset_SigmaP_two_of_EXP_subset_PPoly hE).trans (SigmaP_subset_PH 2)
  exact P_ne_EXP (Set.Subset.antisymm P_subset_EXP h1)

end Complexity

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Size
import TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.MeyerTab

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Meyer's theorem: the head-relative tableau

The semantic layer of the proof of [AB09, Thm 6.20]: the *head-relative tableau* of a
run of `M` and its *local rule*. For a configuration `c` of `M` on input `x`:

* `Complexity.Meyer.RW c h d` — the content of work tape `h` at offset `d ∈ ℤ` from its
  head;
* `Complexity.Meyer.RI c d` — the input symbol at offset `d` from the input head (the
  input `x` padded with blanks, `Complexity.Meyer.xhat`).

One step of `M` changes these only locally: the new state and output summary, and every
cell at offset `d` after the step, are determined by the state, the symbols under the
heads, and the cell at offset `d + m` before the step (`m` the head's move) — or, at the
cell just left, by the written symbol (`RW_step`, `RI_step`). This is what lets the
`Σ₂` verifier check a guessed tableau with a constant number of queries per instance.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Meyer.xhat`, `Complexity.Meyer.RW`, `Complexity.Meyer.RI`.
* `Complexity.Meyer.sgnZ` — the signed offset `±a`.
* (width-`w` words are `Complexity.enumWord` of `ClassNP/EXP.lean`, with lemmas here.)

## Main results

* `Complexity.Meyer.tabAns_sym_some`, `Complexity.Meyer.tabAns_sym_none` — the
  tableau machine's walked answers are the head-relative cells.
* `Complexity.Meyer.RW_step`, `Complexity.Meyer.RI_step`, `Complexity.Meyer.SS_step` —
  the local rule of one step.
* `Complexity.Meyer.tabFun_query` — the answer to a well-formed query.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§6.4, Theorem 6.20, pp. 114–115.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Meyer

open Turing Turing.FinTM Complexity.TimeHierarchy

/-! ### Head-relative cells -/

/-- The input padded with blanks: position `z ≥ 1` holds `x[z - 1]` (blank beyond the
input), positions `z ≤ 0` are blank. -/
def xhat (x : List Bool) (z : ℤ) : Option Bool :=
  if 1 ≤ z then x[(z - 1).toNat]? else none

/-- The signed offset `-a` (for `neg`) or `a`. -/
def sgnZ (neg : Bool) (a : ℕ) : ℤ := if neg then -(a : ℤ) else a

variable {M : FinTM Bool} {x : List Bool}

/-- **Work tape `h` at offset `d` from its head.** -/
def RW (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (h : Fin M.k) (d : ℤ) : Option Bool :=
  c.workTapes h (c.workTapePos h + d)

/-- **The input at offset `d` from the input head.** -/
def RI (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (d : ℤ) : Option Bool :=
  xhat x ((c.inputPos.val : ℤ) + d)

/-- The input symbol is the input cell at offset `0`. -/
theorem inputSymbol_eq_xhat (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) :
    c.inputSymbol = RI c 0 := by
  simp only [RI, add_zero, xhat]
  by_cases h0 : c.inputPos.val = 0
  · have : c.inputPos = 0 := Fin.ext h0
    simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, this]
  · have hp := c.inputPos.isLt
    rw [if_pos (by omega)]
    have h := inputSymbol_at c (c.inputPos.val - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [h]
    congr 1
    omega

/-- The work symbols are the work cells at offset `0`. -/
theorem workTapeSymbols_eq_RW (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (h : Fin M.k) :
    c.workTapeSymbols h = RW c h 0 := by
  simp [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, RW]

/-! ### The walked answers -/

/-- Walking right on the input clamps at the right boundary. -/
theorem iterate_move_pos {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)) (a : ℕ) :
    ((fun q => moveInputPos q .pos)^[a] p).val = min (p.val + a) (n + 1) := by
  induction a generalizing p with
  | zero => simp; omega
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ih]
    by_cases hp : p.val = n + 1
    · have : moveInputPos p .pos = p := by
        have he : p = ⟨n + 1, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext hp
        rw [he]; exact moveInputPos_rightBoundary
      rw [this]; omega
    · rw [moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ hp]; simp; omega

/-- Walking left on the input clamps at the left boundary. -/
theorem iterate_move_neg {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)) (a : ℕ) :
    ((fun q => moveInputPos q .neg)^[a] p).val = p.val - a := by
  induction a generalizing p with
  | zero => simp
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ih]
    by_cases hp : p = 0
    · subst hp
      rw [show moveInputPos (0 : Fin (n + 2)) .neg = 0 from moveInputPos_leftBoundary]
      simp
    · rw [moveInputPos_neg_of_ne_left _ hp]; simp; omega

/-- The input walk of `a` cells. -/
theorem wstep_none_iterate (neg bl : Bool) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (a : ℕ) :
    (wstep M (.sym none neg bl))^[a] c =
      { c with inputPos := (fun q => moveInputPos q (walkDir neg))^[a] c.inputPos } := by
  induction a generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply]
    rfl

/-- **The walked input answer** is the input cell at the signed offset. -/
theorem walked_input (neg bl : Bool) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (a : ℕ) :
    ((wstep M (.sym none neg bl))^[a] c).inputSymbol = RI c (sgnZ neg a) := by
  rw [wstep_none_iterate, inputSymbol_eq_xhat]
  simp only [RI, add_zero, xhat, sgnZ]
  have hp := c.inputPos.isLt
  cases neg
  · simp only [walkDir, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    rw [iterate_move_pos]
    by_cases hle : c.inputPos.val + a ≤ x.length + 1
    · rw [min_eq_left hle]; push_cast; rfl
    · rw [min_eq_right (by omega)]
      rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega), List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]
  · simp only [walkDir, if_true]
    rw [iterate_move_neg]
    by_cases hle : a ≤ c.inputPos.val
    · rw [show ((c.inputPos.val - a : ℕ) : ℤ) = (c.inputPos.val : ℤ) + -(a : ℤ) by omega]
    · rw [show c.inputPos.val - a = 0 by omega]
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero]
      rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]

/-- The work walk of `a` cells. -/
theorem wstep_some_iterate (h : Fin M.k) (neg bl : Bool) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (a : ℕ) :
    (wstep M (.sym (some h) neg bl))^[a] c =
      { c with
        workTapePos := (Function.update c.workTapePos h (c.workTapePos h + sgnZ neg a)) } := by
  induction a generalizing c with
  | zero => cases c; simp [sgnZ]
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ih]
    simp only [wstep, Function.update_self, sgnZ, walkDir]
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i = h
    · subst hi; cases neg <;> simp <;> ring
    · simp [Function.update_of_ne hi]

/-- **The walked work answer** is the work cell at the signed offset. -/
theorem walked_work (h : Fin M.k) (neg bl : Bool) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (a : ℕ) :
    ((wstep M (.sym (some h) neg bl))^[a] c).workTapeSymbols h = RW c h (sgnZ neg a) := by
  rw [wstep_some_iterate]
  simp [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, RW]

/-- **The tableau answer for a work-cell selector.** -/
theorem tabAns_sym_some (h : Fin M.k) (neg bl : Bool) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (a : ℕ) :
    tabAns M (.sym (some h) neg bl) c a = symBit bl (RW c h (sgnZ neg a)) := by
  simp only [tabAns, selAnswer, walked_work]

/-- **The tableau answer for an input-cell selector.** -/
theorem tabAns_sym_none (neg bl : Bool) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (a : ℕ) :
    tabAns M (.sym none neg bl) c a = symBit bl (RI c (sgnZ neg a)) := by
  simp only [tabAns, selAnswer, walked_input]

/-- **The tableau answer for a state selector.** -/
theorem tabAns_st (σ : Option M.State) (r₀ : OutReg) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (a : ℕ) :
    tabAns M (.st σ r₀) c a = decide (c.state = σ ∧ OutReg.ofList c.output = r₀) := by
  simp only [tabAns, selAnswer]

/-! ### The local rule -/

variable (M) in
/-- The symbols under the heads: the input symbol and the work symbols. -/
abbrev Rd := Option Bool × (Fin M.k → Option Bool)

/-- The reads of a configuration. -/
def reads (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) : Rd M := (RI c 0, fun h => RW c h 0)

/-- The state and output summary of a configuration. -/
def SS (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) : Option M.State × OutReg := (c.state, OutReg.ofList c.output)

variable (M) in
/-- **The local rule for the state**: a live state takes its transition, emitting into
the summary; a halted one stays. -/
def ruleS (σ : Option M.State × OutReg) (ρ : Rd M) : Option M.State × OutReg :=
  match σ.1 with
  | none => σ
  | some q => ((M.tm.tr q ρ.1 ρ.2).state, σ.2.push (M.tm.tr q ρ.1 ρ.2).output)

/-- The symbol at the head after an optional write `w` over the read symbol `r`. -/
def wsym (w : Option (Option Bool)) (r : Option Bool) : Option Bool :=
  match w with
  | none => r
  | some s => s

variable (M) in
/-- **The local rule for a work cell**: with move `m` and write `w` on tape `h`, the cell
at offset `d` afterwards is the written symbol if `d + m = 0`, else the old cell at
offset `d + m`; nothing changes if halted. `f` is the old row of tape `h`. -/
def ruleW (oq : Option M.State) (ρ : Rd M) (h : Fin M.k) (d : ℤ) (f : ℤ → Option Bool) :
    Option Bool :=
  match oq with
  | none => f d
  | some q =>
    if d + ((M.tm.tr q ρ.1 ρ.2).workTapes h).2 = 0 then
      wsym ((M.tm.tr q ρ.1 ρ.2).workTapes h).1 (ρ.2 h)
    else f (d + ((M.tm.tr q ρ.1 ρ.2).workTapes h).2)

variable (M) in
/-- **The local rule for an input cell**: the input head moves by `m` unless the move is
clamped — detected as "blank under the head and blank at offset `m`" — and nothing
changes if halted. `f` is the old input row. -/
def ruleI (oq : Option M.State) (ρ : Rd M) (d : ℤ) (f : ℤ → Option Bool) : Option Bool :=
  match oq with
  | none => f d
  | some q =>
    if ρ.1 = none ∧ f ((M.tm.tr q ρ.1 ρ.2).inputTape) = none then f d
    else f (d + (M.tm.tr q ρ.1 ρ.2).inputTape)

/-- One step of a live configuration in terms of its reads. -/
theorem step_eq (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (q : M.State) (hq : c.state = some q) :
    M.tm.step c = (M.tm.tr q (reads c).1 (reads c).2).apply c := by
  have h1 : c.workTapeSymbols = (reads c).2 := by
    funext h; simp [reads, workTapeSymbols_eq_RW]
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hq, inputSymbol_eq_xhat]
  rw [h1]
  rfl

/-- **The local rule for the state** holds along a run. -/
theorem SS_step (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) : SS (M.tm.step c) = ruleS M (SS c) (reads c) := by
  cases hq : c.state with
  | none => simp [SS, ruleS, hq]
  | some q =>
    rw [step_eq c q hq]
    simp [SS, ruleS, hq, Action.apply, OutReg.ofList_push]

/-- **The local rule for work cells** holds along a run. -/
theorem RW_step (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (h : Fin M.k) (d : ℤ) :
    RW (M.tm.step c) h d = ruleW M c.state (reads c) h d (RW c h) := by
  cases hq : c.state with
  | none => simp [ruleW, MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt hq]
  | some q =>
    rw [step_eq c q hq]
    simp only [RW, ruleW, Action.apply]
    generalize ((M.tm.tr q (reads c).1 (reads c).2).workTapes h) = wm
    obtain ⟨w, m⟩ := wm
    cases w with
    | none =>
      simp only [wsym]
      split_ifs with hd
      · simp [reads, RW]; congr 1; omega
      · congr 1; ring
    | some s =>
      simp only [wsym]
      split_ifs with hd
      · rw [Function.update_apply, if_pos (by omega)]
      · rw [Function.update_apply, if_neg (by omega)]; congr 1; ring

/-- Blank input cells are exactly the cells outside `[1, |x|]`. -/
theorem xhat_eq_none (z : ℤ) : xhat x z = none ↔ z < 1 ∨ (x.length : ℤ) < z := by
  simp only [xhat]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff]; omega
  · simp; omega

/-- **The local rule for input cells** holds along a run.

**Proof sketch.** Case on the move: an unclamped move shifts the offset by `m`; a clamped
move happens exactly at a boundary, where the cell under the head and at offset `m` are
blank — and if the head is inside with both blank, the input is empty and every cell is
blank. -/
theorem RI_step (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (d : ℤ) :
    RI (M.tm.step c) d = ruleI M c.state (reads c) d (RI c) := by
  cases hq : c.state with
  | none => simp [ruleI, MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt hq]
  | some q =>
    rw [step_eq c q hq]
    simp only [RI, ruleI, Action.apply]
    generalize (M.tm.tr q (reads c).1 (reads c).2).inputTape = m
    have hp := c.inputPos.isLt
    have hr : (reads c).1 = xhat x (c.inputPos.val : ℤ) := by simp [reads, RI]
    rw [hr]
    cases m with
    | zero => simp
    | pos =>
      by_cases he : c.inputPos.val = x.length + 1
      · have hpe : c.inputPos = ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext he
        rw [hpe, show moveInputPos (⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) SignType.pos =
          ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ from moveInputPos_rightBoundary]
        rw [if_pos ⟨(xhat_eq_none _).mpr (by right; omega),
          (xhat_eq_none _).mpr (by right; simp; omega)⟩]
      · rw [moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ he]
        split_ifs with hc
        · -- clamping condition with the head inside: the input is empty
          have h1 := (xhat_eq_none _).mp hc.1
          have h2 := (xhat_eq_none _).mp hc.2
          have hx : x.length = 0 := by simp at h2; omega
          rw [(xhat_eq_none _).mpr (by omega), (xhat_eq_none _).mpr (by omega)]
        · congr 1; simp; ring
    | neg =>
      by_cases he : c.inputPos = 0
      · rw [he, show moveInputPos (0 : Fin (x.length + 2)) .neg = 0 from
          moveInputPos_leftBoundary]
        rw [if_pos ⟨(xhat_eq_none _).mpr (by left; simp), (xhat_eq_none _).mpr (by left; simp)⟩]
      · have h0 : c.inputPos.val ≠ 0 := fun h => he (Fin.ext h)
        rw [moveInputPos_neg_of_ne_left _ he]
        split_ifs with hc
        · have h1 := (xhat_eq_none _).mp hc.1
          have h2 := (xhat_eq_none _).mp hc.2
          have hx : x.length = 0 := by simp at h2; omega
          rw [(xhat_eq_none _).mpr (by omega), (xhat_eq_none _).mpr (by omega)]
        · congr 1; simp; omega

/-! ### The initial row -/

/-- The initial state and output summary. -/
theorem SS_init : SS (M.tm.initCfg x) = (some M.tm.q₀, OutReg.empty) := rfl

/-- The initial work tapes are blank. -/
theorem RW_init (h : Fin M.k) (d : ℤ) : RW (M.tm.initCfg x) h d = none := rfl

/-- The initial input row: the head is on the first input cell. -/
theorem RI_init (d : ℤ) : RI (M.tm.initCfg x) d = xhat x (1 + d) := rfl

/-! ### Width-`w` binary words

The words are `Complexity.enumWord` (`ClassNP/EXP.lean`), the enumerator's width-`w`
little-endian code. -/

/-- The word has width `w`. -/
@[simp] theorem length_enumWord (w v : ℕ) : (enumWord w v).length = w := by
  induction w generalizing v with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ w ih => simp [enumWord, ih]

/-- The value of a width-`w` word of a number below `2^w`. -/
theorem ctrVal_enumWord (w v : ℕ) (hv : v < 2 ^ w) : ctrVal (enumWord w v) = v := by
  induction w generalizing v with
  | zero => simp at hv; subst hv; rfl
  | succ w ih =>
    simp only [enumWord, ctrVal]
    rw [ih (v / 2) (by rw [pow_succ] at hv; omega)]
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one v with h | h <;> simp [h] <;> omega

/-- Every width-`w` word is the word of its value. -/
theorem enumWord_ctrVal (u : List Bool) : enumWord u.length (ctrVal u) = u := by
  induction u with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b u ih =>
    simp only [List.length_cons, enumWord, ctrVal]
    cases b
    · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, zero_add]
      rw [show 2 * ctrVal u / 2 = ctrVal u by omega, ih]
      simp
    · simp only [if_true]
      rw [show (1 + 2 * ctrVal u) / 2 = ctrVal u by omega, ih]
      simp only [List.cons.injEq, and_true]
      simp

/-- The width-`w` word of `0` is all `false`. -/
theorem enumWord_zero (w : ℕ) : enumWord w 0 = List.replicate w false := by
  induction w with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ w ih => simp [enumWord, ih, List.replicate_succ]

/-- The width-`w` word of `2^w - 1` is all `true`. -/
theorem enumWord_ones (w : ℕ) : enumWord w (2 ^ w - 1) = List.replicate w true := by
  induction w with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ w ih =>
    simp only [enumWord, List.replicate_succ]
    have h1 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ w := Nat.one_le_two_pow
    rw [show (2 ^ (w + 1) - 1) / 2 = 2 ^ w - 1 by rw [pow_succ]; omega, ih]
    simp only [List.cons.injEq, and_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    rw [pow_succ]; omega

/-- **Fixed-width increment** on words of numbers: `v + 1 < 2^w` increments. -/
theorem incFixed_enumWord (w v : ℕ) (hv : v + 1 < 2 ^ w) :
    incFixed (enumWord w v) = some (enumWord w (v + 1)) := by
  induction w generalizing v with
  | zero => simp at hv
  | succ w ih =>
    simp only [enumWord]
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd v with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
    · subst hk
      simp only [show (k + k) % 2 = 0 by omega, show (k + k + 1) % 2 = 1 by omega,
        show (k + k) / 2 = k by omega, show (k + k + 1) / 2 = k by omega]
      simp [incFixed]
    · subst hk
      simp only [show (2 * k + 1) % 2 = 1 by omega, show (2 * k + 1 + 1) % 2 = 0 by omega,
        show (2 * k + 1) / 2 = k by omega, show (2 * k + 1 + 1) / 2 = k + 1 by omega]
      simp [incFixed, ih k (by rw [pow_succ] at hv; omega)]

/-- Increment overflows exactly on the all-`true` word. -/
theorem incFixed_eq_none_iff (u : List Bool) : incFixed u = none ↔ u = List.replicate u.length true := by
  induction u with
  | nil => simp [incFixed]
  | cons b u ih =>
    cases b <;> simp [incFixed, ih, List.replicate_succ]

/-- Appending zeros at the high end keeps the value. -/
theorem ctrVal_append_zeros (l : List Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    ctrVal (l ++ List.replicate k false) = ctrVal l := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih => simp [List.replicate_succ, ctrVal] at ih ⊢; exact ih
  | cons b l ih => simp [ctrVal, ih]

/-- **The padded binary length code**: `Nat.bits j` padded with zeros to width `w` is the
width-`w` word of `j`. -/
theorem bits_pad (w j : ℕ) (hj : j < 2 ^ w) :
    Nat.bits j ++ List.replicate (w - (Nat.bits j).length) false = enumWord w j := by
  have hlen : (Nat.bits j).length ≤ w := by
    rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]; exact Nat.size_le.mpr hj
  have h := enumWord_ctrVal (Nat.bits j ++ List.replicate (w - (Nat.bits j).length) false)
  rw [ctrVal_append_zeros, ctrVal_bits] at h
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate] at h
  rw [show (Nat.bits j).length + (w - (Nat.bits j).length) = w by omega] at h
  exact h.symm

/-! ### The answer to a well-formed query -/

variable (M) in
/-- **The answer to a well-formed query** is the tableau answer for its decoded fields. -/
theorem tabFun_query (sel : Sel M) (t a x : List Bool) :
    tabFun M (query (encodeSel sel) t a x) =
      tabAns M sel (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) (ctrVal t)) (ctrVal a) := by
  simp [tabFun, parseQ_query]

end Complexity.Meyer

import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.NTIME
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.NDCodes
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.ChoiceReplay
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.StepClock
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Seam
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.CfgFacts

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The exhaustive replay of a fixed NDTM

[AB09, §3.2, proof of Theorem 3.2]: the complement of a nondeterministic language is decidable
deterministically in exponential time "by examining all the possibilities for the machine's
nondeterministic choices", and that simulation suffices for the nondeterministic time
hierarchy. `Turing.FinNDTM.exists_exhaustiveDecider` is that simulation
for a fixed NDTM, as a public generic theorem (user decision 2 of 2026-10-13): on every input on
which all branches halt within `T`, a deterministic machine decides acceptance within
`C·2^{C·(T + 1)}`, with no input-length term. The exponential decider of the hierarchy is then
`BF := E(UN)`, the exhaustive replay of the universal NDTM; its statement is derived here
(`Turing.ndAcceptsWithin_decider_of_universal`, proved).

## Main definitions

No new definitions: the exhaustive replay and `BF` are existential contracts.

## Main results

* `Turing.FinNDTM.exists_exhaustiveDecider` — the exhaustive replay `E` (proved).
* `Turing.ndAcceptsWithin_decider_of_universal` — `BF := E(UN)` (proved).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§3.2, proof of Theorem 3.2.)
-/

namespace Turing

/-! ### The construction of the exhaustive replay (the `xr_` privates)

The semantic and arithmetic parts of the exhaustive replay, read through the published ND
semantics only (that no branch halts at depth `0` is the published
`Turing.NDTM.not_haltsWithin_zero`): a branch of length `|w|` stays within the
radius-`|w|` window; at an all-halting depth `L ≤ T` acceptance within `L` and within `T`
agree; the first all-halting depth exists; the ledger's shape. Then two generic tools for the
machine: the translation of work tapes (a branch started on blank tapes at displaced heads is
the branch from `initCfg`, translated), and the first arrival at a stationary anchor (the
phase host's guard for every leaf row of this file). -/

/-- One step from the radius-`s` window stays in the radius-`s + 1` window, with the output
growing by at most one symbol. -/
private theorem xr_window_stepWith {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : NDTM k Bool S)
    (b : Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (s : ℕ)
    (hpos : ∀ i, |c.workTapePos i| ≤ (s : ℤ))
    (hblank : ∀ i (p : ℤ), (s : ℤ) < |p| → c.workTapes i p = none)
    (hout : c.output.length ≤ s) :
    (∀ i, |(tm.stepWith b c).workTapePos i| ≤ ((s + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
    (∀ i (p : ℤ), ((s + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) < |p| → (tm.stepWith b c).workTapes i p = none) ∧
    (tm.stepWith b c).output.length ≤ s + 1 := by
  cases hq : c.state with
  | none =>
    rw [NDTM.stepWith_of_halt hq]
    refine ⟨fun i => (hpos i).trans (by push_cast; omega), fun i p hp => hblank i p ?_, by omega⟩
    push_cast at hp; linarith
  | some q =>
    rw [NDTM.stepWith_of_some hq]
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i p hp => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 := workTapePos_apply_le (tm.tr b q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols) c i
      have h2 := hpos i
      rw [abs_le] at h1 h2 ⊢
      push_cast
      constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]
    · rw [Action.apply_workTapes]
      have h2 := hpos i
      have hp' : (s : ℤ) < |p| := by push_cast at hp; linarith
      have hne : p ≠ c.workTapePos i := by
        rintro rfl
        exact absurd h2 (not_le.mpr hp')
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hne]
      exact hblank i p hp'
    · rw [Action.apply_output, List.length_append]
      have : (tm.tr b q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).output.toList.length ≤ 1 := by
        cases (tm.tr b q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).output <;> simp
      omega

/-- After a branch of length `|w|` from the initial configuration, every work head lies within
`|w|` of its origin, every cell beyond radius `|w|` is blank, and the output has length at most
`|w|`: the window the clear must blank. -/
private theorem xr_window_runWith {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (tm : NDTM k Bool S) (z w : List Bool) :
    (∀ i, |(tm.runWith w (tm.initCfg z)).workTapePos i| ≤ (w.length : ℤ)) ∧
    (∀ i (p : ℤ), (w.length : ℤ) < |p| → (tm.runWith w (tm.initCfg z)).workTapes i p = none) ∧
    (tm.runWith w (tm.initCfg z)).output.length ≤ w.length := by
  suffices H : ∀ (w : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S z) (s : ℕ),
      (∀ i, |c.workTapePos i| ≤ (s : ℤ)) →
      (∀ i (p : ℤ), (s : ℤ) < |p| → c.workTapes i p = none) →
      c.output.length ≤ s →
      (∀ i, |(tm.runWith w c).workTapePos i| ≤ ((s + w.length : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
      (∀ i (p : ℤ), ((s + w.length : ℕ) : ℤ) < |p| → (tm.runWith w c).workTapes i p = none) ∧
      (tm.runWith w c).output.length ≤ s + w.length by
    have h := H w (tm.initCfg z) 0
      (fun i => by rw [NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapePos]; simp)
      (fun i p _ => by rw [NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapes])
      (by rw [NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_output]; simp)
    simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using h
  intro w
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    intro c s h1 h2 h3
    simp only [NDTM.runWith_nil, List.length_nil, Nat.add_zero]
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  | cons b w ih =>
    intro c s h1 h2 h3
    obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩ := xr_window_stepWith tm b c s h1 h2 h3
    have := ih (tm.stepWith b c) (s + 1) g1 g2 g3
    rw [NDTM.runWith_cons]
    simpa only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm 1] using this

/-- At an all-halting depth `L ≤ T`, acceptance within `L` and within `T` agree: one direction
is monotonicity, the other truncates an accepting word of length `T` at `L`. -/
private theorem xr_accepts_iff_of_halts (N : FinNDTM Bool) (z : List Bool) {L T : ℕ}
    (hL : N.tm.HaltsWithin z L) (hLT : L ≤ T) :
    N.AcceptsWithin z L ↔ N.AcceptsWithin z T := by
  refine ⟨fun h => h.mono hLT, fun h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hhalt, hout⟩ := FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff.mp h
  have htake : (w.take L).length = L := by rw [List.length_take, hw]; omega
  have hstop := NDTM.haltsWithin_iff.mp hL (w.take L) htake
  have hsplit : N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg z) = N.tm.runWith (w.take L) (N.tm.initCfg z) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop L w]
    rw [NDTM.runWith_append, NDTM.runWith_of_halt _ hstop]
  rw [hsplit] at hout
  exact FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨w.take L, htake, hstop, hout⟩

/-- The first all-halting depth exists below any all-halting bound, is positive, and answers
as the bound does: the deepening terminates by depth `T`, never at depth `0`. -/
private theorem xr_first_depth (N : FinNDTM Bool) (z : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hT : N.tm.HaltsWithin z T) :
    ∃ L, 0 < L ∧ L ≤ T ∧ N.tm.HaltsWithin z L ∧ (∀ L' < L, ¬ N.tm.HaltsWithin z L') ∧
      (N.AcceptsWithin z L ↔ N.AcceptsWithin z T) := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ L, N.tm.HaltsWithin z L := ⟨T, hT⟩
  refine ⟨Nat.find hex, ?_, Nat.find_min' hex hT, Nat.find_spec hex,
    fun L' hL' => Nat.find_min hex hL', xr_accepts_iff_of_halts N z (Nat.find_spec hex)
      (Nat.find_min' hex hT)⟩
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.find hex) with h0 | h0
  · exact absurd (h0 ▸ Nat.find_spec hex) (NDTM.not_haltsWithin_zero N.tm z)
  · exact h0

/-- The ledger's shape, with two steps of slack for the dispatch and the answer:
`Σ_{L ≤ T} 2^L · A(L + 1) + 2 ≤ (A + 3)·2^{(A + 3)(T + 1)}`. -/
private theorem xr_ledger (A T : ℕ) :
    ∑ L ∈ Finset.range (T + 1), 2 ^ L * (A * (L + 1)) + 2 ≤
      (A + 3) * 2 ^ ((A + 3) * (T + 1)) := by
  have hterm : ∀ L ∈ Finset.range (T + 1), 2 ^ L * (A * (L + 1)) ≤ 2 ^ T * (A * (T + 1)) := by
    intro L hL
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hL
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left A (by omega))
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range] at hsum
  change _ ≤ (T + 1) * (2 ^ T * (A * (T + 1))) at hsum
  have hlin : T + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (T + 1) := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le
  have h2 : 2 ^ T ≤ 2 ^ (T + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  have hpow : 2 ^ (T + 1) * 2 ^ (T + 1) * 2 ^ (T + 1) ≤ 2 ^ ((A + 3) * (T + 1)) := by
    rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by nlinarith)
  have hone : 1 ≤ 2 ^ ((A + 3) * (T + 1)) := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  calc ∑ L ∈ Finset.range (T + 1), 2 ^ L * (A * (L + 1)) + 2
      ≤ (T + 1) * (2 ^ T * (A * (T + 1))) + 2 := Nat.add_le_add_right hsum 2
    _ = A * ((T + 1) * 2 ^ T * (T + 1)) + 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ A * (2 ^ (T + 1) * 2 ^ (T + 1) * 2 ^ (T + 1)) + 2 :=
        Nat.add_le_add_right
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_left A (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul hlin h2) hlin)) 2
    _ ≤ A * 2 ^ ((A + 3) * (T + 1)) + 2 := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left A hpow) 2
    _ ≤ (A + 3) * 2 ^ ((A + 3) * (T + 1)) := by nlinarith [hone]

/-! #### Translation of work tapes -/

/-- The configuration `c` with work tape `i` translated by `δ i`: cell `p` holds what cell
`p - δ i` held, and the head moves by `δ i`; the state, input head and output are `c`'s. -/
private def xr_shift {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (δ : Fin k → ℤ) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) :
    Cfg k Bool S x :=
  ⟨c.state, c.inputPos, fun i p => c.workTapes i (p - δ i), fun i => c.workTapePos i + δ i,
    c.output⟩

/-- A translated configuration reads the same work symbols. -/
private theorem xr_workTapeSymbols_shift {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (δ : Fin k → ℤ)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) : (xr_shift δ c).workTapeSymbols = c.workTapeSymbols := by
  funext i
  rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq, Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
  show c.workTapes i (c.workTapePos i + δ i - δ i) = _
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right]

/-- Applying an action commutes with translation. -/
private theorem xr_apply_shift {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (δ : Fin k → ℤ)
    (a : Action k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) :
    a.apply (xr_shift δ c) = xr_shift δ (a.apply c) := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · show (a.apply (xr_shift δ c)).state = (a.apply c).state
    rw [Action.apply_state, Action.apply_state]
  · show (a.apply (xr_shift δ c)).inputPos = (a.apply c).inputPos
    rw [Action.apply_inputPos, Action.apply_inputPos]
    rfl
  · funext i p
    show (a.apply (xr_shift δ c)).workTapes i p = (a.apply c).workTapes i (p - δ i)
    rw [Action.apply_workTapes, Action.apply_workTapes, xr_workTapeSymbols_shift]
    show Function.update (fun p => c.workTapes i (p - δ i)) (c.workTapePos i + δ i) _ p = _
    by_cases hp : p = c.workTapePos i + δ i
    · subst hp
      rw [Function.update_self, add_sub_cancel_right, Function.update_self]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hp, Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
  · funext i
    show (a.apply (xr_shift δ c)).workTapePos i = (a.apply c).workTapePos i + δ i
    rw [Action.apply_workTapePos, Action.apply_workTapePos]
    show c.workTapePos i + δ i + _ = c.workTapePos i + _ + δ i
    ring
  · show (a.apply (xr_shift δ c)).output = (a.apply c).output
    rw [Action.apply_output, Action.apply_output]
    rfl

/-- One nondeterministic step commutes with translation. -/
private theorem xr_stepWith_shift {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (N : NDTM k Bool S)
    (δ : Fin k → ℤ) (b : Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) :
    N.stepWith b (xr_shift δ c) = xr_shift δ (N.stepWith b c) := by
  cases hq : c.state with
  | none =>
    rw [NDTM.stepWith_of_halt hq, NDTM.stepWith_of_halt (show (xr_shift δ c).state = none from hq)]
  | some q =>
    rw [NDTM.stepWith_of_some hq,
      NDTM.stepWith_of_some (show (xr_shift δ c).state = some q from hq),
      Cfg.inputSymbol_congr (xr_shift δ c) c rfl, xr_workTapeSymbols_shift, xr_apply_shift]

/-- A branch commutes with translation: the branch along `w` from a translated configuration
is the translated branch. -/
private theorem xr_runWith_shift {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (N : NDTM k Bool S)
    (δ : Fin k → ℤ) (w : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) :
    N.runWith w (xr_shift δ c) = xr_shift δ (N.runWith w c) := by
  induction w generalizing c with
  | nil => rw [NDTM.runWith_nil, NDTM.runWith_nil]
  | cons b w ih => rw [NDTM.runWith_cons, NDTM.runWith_cons, xr_stepWith_shift, ih]

/-! #### The first arrival at a stationary anchor -/

/-- A configuration fixed by one step is fixed by every run. -/
private theorem xr_runFrom_fixed {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (d : Cfg k Bool S x) (hd : tm.step d = d) (n : ℕ) : tm.runFrom d n = d := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero
  | succ n ih => rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih, hd]

open MultiTapeTM in
/-- One step of a run. -/
private theorem xr_runFrom_one {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (d : Cfg k Bool S x) : tm.runFrom d 1 = tm.step d := by
  rw [runFrom_succ_eq_step', runFrom_zero]

/-- Two steps of a run. -/
private theorem xr_runFrom_two {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (d : Cfg k Bool S x) : tm.runFrom d 2 = tm.step (tm.step d) := by
  rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, xr_runFrom_one, xr_runFrom_one]

/-- **The first arrival at a stationary anchor.** If a run reaches `c'` in state `a` at time `T`
and `a` is stationary, the first time the state is `a` is at most `T`, reaches `c'` too, and no
earlier state is `a`: the phase host's guard, for free, from an exact-time run lemma. -/
private theorem xr_firstArrival {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (a : S) (hstat : ∀ d : Cfg k Bool S x, d.state = some a → tm.step d = d)
    {c c' : Cfg k Bool S x} {T : ℕ} (h : tm.runFrom c T = c') (hc' : c'.state = some a) :
    ∃ T' ≤ T, tm.runFrom c T' = c' ∧ ∀ u < T', (tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some a := by
  classical
  have hT' : (tm.runFrom c T).state = some a := by rw [h]; exact hc'
  have hex : ∃ u, (tm.runFrom c u).state = some a := ⟨T, hT'⟩
  refine ⟨Nat.find hex, Nat.find_min' hex hT', ?_, fun u hu => Nat.find_min hex hu⟩
  have hsplit : tm.runFrom c T = tm.runFrom (tm.runFrom c (Nat.find hex)) (T - Nat.find hex) := by
    rw [← MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (Nat.find_min' hex hT')]
  rw [xr_runFrom_fixed tm _ (hstat _ (Nat.find_spec hex))] at hsplit
  exact hsplit.symm.trans h
/-! #### The leaf rows

This file's own rows, on `Bool` tapes, each exiting at a stationary anchor `done b`: the
ruler-driven pass (the window clear's engine), the head rewind to a word's origin, the extension
of a word by one `false`, the capture test (which also clears the captured output), the input
rewind and the answer. Their run lemmas give exact times and exact configurations; the phase
host's guard comes from `xr_firstArrival`. -/

/-- The control of the leaf rows. -/
private inductive xr_St where
  | start
  | run
  | aux
  | back (b : Bool)
  | done (b : Bool)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- A silent action: no input move and no emission. -/
private def xr_act {K : ℕ} (mv : Fin K → Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (q : Option xr_St) :
    Action K Bool xr_St := ⟨0, mv, none, q⟩

/-- Write `wr` and move `m` on tape `r` only. -/
private def xr_mv1 {K : ℕ} (r : Fin K) (wr : Option (Option Bool)) (m : SignType) :
    Fin K → Option (Option Bool) × SignType :=
  fun i => if i = r then (wr, m) else (none, 0)

/-- Write `wr` and move `m` on tape `j`, move `m'` on tape `r`. -/
private def xr_mv2 {K : ℕ} (j r : Fin K) (wr : Option (Option Bool)) (m m' : SignType) :
    Fin K → Option (Option Bool) × SignType :=
  fun i => if i = j then (wr, m) else if i = r then (none, m') else (none, 0)

/-- The stationary action at `q`. -/
private def xr_stay {K : ℕ} (q : xr_St) : Action K Bool xr_St :=
  xr_act (fun _ => (none, 0)) (some q)

private theorem xr_cast_pos : ((SignType.pos : SignType) : ℤ) = 1 := rfl
private theorem xr_cast_neg : ((SignType.neg : SignType) : ℤ) = -1 := rfl

/-- A silent action's effect: the state, the writes under the heads, the head moves. -/
private theorem xr_act_apply {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (mv : Fin K → Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (q : Option xr_St) (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x) :
    (xr_act mv q).apply d =
      ⟨q, d.inputPos,
        fun i => Function.update (d.workTapes i) (d.workTapePos i)
          ((mv i).1.getD (d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i))),
        fun i => d.workTapePos i + ((mv i).2 : ℤ), d.output⟩ := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · exact Action.apply_state _ _
  · exact (Action.apply_inputPos _ _).trans (moveInputPos_zero _)
  · funext i
    rw [Action.apply_workTapes, Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
    rfl
  · funext i
    exact Action.apply_workTapePos _ _ _
  · exact (Action.apply_output _ _).trans (List.append_nil _)

/-- A one-tape write-and-move. -/
private theorem xr_mv1_apply {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (r : Fin K) (wr : Option (Option Bool))
    (m : SignType) (q : Option xr_St) (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x) :
    (xr_act (xr_mv1 r wr m) q).apply d =
      ⟨q, d.inputPos,
        Function.update d.workTapes r (Function.update (d.workTapes r) (d.workTapePos r)
          (wr.getD (d.workTapes r (d.workTapePos r)))),
        Function.update d.workTapePos r (d.workTapePos r + (m : ℤ)), d.output⟩ := by
  rw [xr_act_apply]
  congr 1
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : i = r
    · rw [hi]
      simp [xr_mv1]
    · simp [xr_mv1, hi]
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : i = r
    · rw [hi]
      simp [xr_mv1]
    · simp [xr_mv1, hi]

/-- A one-tape move without a write. -/
private theorem xr_mv1_apply_none {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (r : Fin K) (m : SignType)
    (q : Option xr_St) (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x) :
    (xr_act (xr_mv1 r none m) q).apply d =
      ⟨q, d.inputPos, d.workTapes,
        Function.update d.workTapePos r (d.workTapePos r + (m : ℤ)), d.output⟩ := by
  rw [xr_mv1_apply]
  congr 1
  simp

/-- A two-tape move: a write-and-move on `j`, a move on `r`. -/
private theorem xr_mv2_apply {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (j r : Fin K) (hjr : j ≠ r)
    (wr : Option (Option Bool)) (m m' : SignType) (q : Option xr_St) (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x) :
    (xr_act (xr_mv2 j r wr m m') q).apply d =
      ⟨q, d.inputPos,
        Function.update d.workTapes j (Function.update (d.workTapes j) (d.workTapePos j)
          (wr.getD (d.workTapes j (d.workTapePos j)))),
        fun i => if i = j then d.workTapePos j + (m : ℤ)
          else if i = r then d.workTapePos r + (m' : ℤ) else d.workTapePos i, d.output⟩ := by
  rw [xr_act_apply]
  congr 1
  · funext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · rw [hij]
      simp [xr_mv2]
    · by_cases hir : i = r
      · rw [hir]
        simp [xr_mv2, Ne.symm hjr]
      · simp [xr_mv2, hij, hir]
  · funext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · rw [hij]
      simp [xr_mv2]
    · by_cases hir : i = r
      · rw [hir]
        simp [xr_mv2, Ne.symm hjr]
      · simp [xr_mv2, hij, hir]

/-- A state whose table is the stationary action fixes every configuration in that state. -/
private theorem xr_stay_step {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM K Bool xr_St) (q : xr_St)
    (htr : ∀ inp w, tm.tr q inp w = xr_stay q) (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x) (hd : d.state = some q) :
    tm.step d = d := by
  rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hd, htr, xr_stay, xr_act_apply]
  apply Cfg.ext
  · exact hd.symm
  · rfl
  · funext i
    simp
  · funext i
    simp
  · rfl

/-- **The return pass** of the leaf rows. From `back b` with the head on the rightmost of the `m`
non-blank cells `o, …, o + m - 1` and a blank at `o - 1`, `m + 1` steps write `wb` on those `m`
cells, return the head to `o`, and stop at `done b`. -/
private theorem xr_back_run {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM K Bool xr_St) (r : Fin K)
    (wb : Option (Option Bool))
    (hsome : ∀ (b : Bool) inp w s, w r = some s →
      tm.tr (.back b) inp w = xr_act (xr_mv1 r wb SignType.neg) (some (.back b)))
    (hnone : ∀ (b : Bool) inp w, w r = none →
      tm.tr (.back b) inp w = xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.pos) (some (.done b)))
    (b : Bool) (o : ℤ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x, d.state = some (.back b) → d.workTapePos r = o + m - 1 →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < m → d.workTapes r (o + i) ≠ none) → d.workTapes r (o - 1) = none →
      tm.runFrom d (m + 1) =
        ⟨some (.done b), d.inputPos,
          Function.update d.workTapes r
            (fun p => if o ≤ p ∧ p < o + m then wb.getD (d.workTapes r p) else d.workTapes r p),
          Function.update d.workTapePos r o, d.output⟩ := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro d hd hpos _ hleft
    have hread : d.workTapeSymbols r = none := by
      rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq, hpos]
      simpa using hleft
    rw [show (0 : ℕ) + 1 = 1 from rfl, xr_runFrom_one, MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hd,
      hnone b _ _ hread, xr_mv1_apply_none]
    congr 1
    · symm
      rw [Function.update_eq_self_iff]
      funext p
      split_ifs with h
      · exfalso
        push_cast at h
        omega
      · rfl
    · rw [hpos, xr_cast_pos]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
  | succ m ih =>
    intro d hd hpos hcells hleft
    have hcur : d.workTapes r (o + m) ≠ none := hcells m (by omega)
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hcur
    have hpos' : d.workTapePos r = o + m := by rw [hpos]; push_cast; ring
    have hread : d.workTapeSymbols r = some s := by
      rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq, hpos', hs]
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hd, hsome b _ _ s hread,
      xr_mv1_apply, hpos', xr_cast_neg]
    have hX : ∀ p : ℤ, p ≠ o + m →
        Function.update (d.workTapes r) (o + m) (wb.getD (d.workTapes r (o + m))) p =
          d.workTapes r p := fun p hp => Function.update_of_ne hp _ _
    rw [ih _ rfl ?_ ?_ ?_]
    · dsimp only
      simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_idem]
      congr 1
      refine congrArg (Function.update d.workTapes r) (funext fun p => ?_)
      dsimp only
      by_cases hp : p = o + m
      · rw [hp, Function.update_self, if_neg (fun h => lt_irrefl _ h.2),
          if_pos ⟨by omega, by push_cast; omega⟩]
      · rw [hX p hp]
        by_cases h1 : o ≤ p ∧ p < o + m
        · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos ⟨h1.1, by push_cast; omega⟩]
        · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg (by push_cast at h1 ⊢; omega)]
    · dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_self]
      omega
    · intro i hi
      dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_self, hX _ (by omega)]
      exact hcells i (by omega)
    · dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_self, hX _ (by omega)]
      exact hleft

/-- **The forward scan** of the leaf rows: from `run` with the head at `o` and `m` non-blank
cells ahead, `m` steps move the head to `o + m` and change nothing else. -/
private theorem xr_fwd_run {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM K Bool xr_St) (r : Fin K)
    (hsome : ∀ inp w s, w r = some s →
      tm.tr .run inp w = xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.pos) (some .run))
    (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ (o : ℤ) (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x), d.state = some .run → d.workTapePos r = o →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < m → d.workTapes r (o + i) ≠ none) →
      tm.runFrom d m =
        ⟨some .run, d.inputPos, d.workTapes, Function.update d.workTapePos r (o + m),
          d.output⟩ := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro o d hd hpos _
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · exact hd
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext i
      dsimp only
      by_cases hi : i = r
      · rw [hi, Function.update_self, hpos]
        simp
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hi]
    · rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    intro o d hd hpos hcells
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp (hcells 0 (by omega))
    have hread : d.workTapeSymbols r = some s := by
      rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq, hpos]
      simpa using hs
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hd, hsome _ _ s hread,
      xr_mv1_apply_none, hpos, xr_cast_pos]
    rw [ih (o + 1) _ rfl (by dsimp only; rw [Function.update_self]) ?_]
    · dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_idem]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    · intro i hi
      dsimp only
      have := hcells (i + 1) (by omega)
      push_cast at this ⊢
      convert this using 2
      ring

/-- **The rewind**: one step left, then left while reading a symbol, then one step right at the
blank. -/
private def xr_rewindTM (K : ℕ) (r : Fin K) : MultiTapeTM K Bool xr_St where
  q₀ := .start
  tr := fun q _ w =>
    match q with
    | .start => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.neg) (some (.back true))
    | .back b =>
      match w r with
      | some _ => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.neg) (some (.back b))
      | none => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.pos) (some (.done b))
    | q => xr_stay q

/-- From any head position `p₀ ≤ |u|` on the word `u` at the origin, the rewind returns the head
to `0` in `p₀ + 2` steps, changes nothing else, and stops at `done true`. -/
private theorem xr_rewindTM_run {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (r : Fin K) (u : List Bool) (p₀ : ℕ)
    (hp₀ : p₀ ≤ u.length) (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x) (hd : d.state = some .start)
    (hr : d.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape u) (hpos : d.workTapePos r = p₀) :
    (xr_rewindTM K r).runFrom d (p₀ + 2) =
      ⟨some (.done true), d.inputPos, d.workTapes, Function.update d.workTapePos r 0,
        d.output⟩ := by
  rw [show p₀ + 2 = (p₀ + 1) + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step,
    MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hd,
    show (xr_rewindTM K r).tr .start _ _ =
      xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.neg) (some (.back true)) from rfl,
    xr_mv1_apply_none, hpos, xr_cast_neg]
  rw [xr_back_run (xr_rewindTM K r) r none
    (fun b inp w s hs => by simp [xr_rewindTM, hs]) (fun b inp w hw => by simp [xr_rewindTM, hw])
    true 0 p₀ _ rfl ?_ ?_ ?_]
  · dsimp only
    rw [Function.update_idem]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.update_eq_self_iff]
    funext p
    simp
  · dsimp only
    rw [Function.update_self]
    ring
  · intro i hi
    dsimp only
    rw [zero_add, hr, FinTM.bufferTape_nat, ne_eq, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff]
    omega
  · dsimp only
    rw [hr]
    simp

/-- **The extension**: right while reading a symbol, write `false` at the blank and turn, return
to the origin: the word grows by one `false`. -/
private def xr_extendTM (K : ℕ) (r : Fin K) : MultiTapeTM K Bool xr_St where
  q₀ := .run
  tr := fun q _ w =>
    match q with
    | .run =>
      match w r with
      | some _ => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.pos) (some .run)
      | none => xr_act (xr_mv1 r (some (some false)) SignType.neg) (some (.back true))
    | .back b =>
      match w r with
      | some _ => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.neg) (some (.back b))
      | none => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.pos) (some (.done b))
    | q => xr_stay q

/-- From the origin of the word `u`, the extension writes `u ++ [false]` in `2|u| + 2` steps,
returns the head to `0`, changes nothing else, and stops at `done true`. -/
private theorem xr_extendTM_run {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (r : Fin K) (u : List Bool)
    (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x) (hd : d.state = some .run)
    (hr : d.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape u) (hpos : d.workTapePos r = 0) :
    (xr_extendTM K r).runFrom d (2 * u.length + 2) =
      ⟨some (.done true), d.inputPos,
        Function.update d.workTapes r (FinTM.bufferTape (u ++ [false])),
        Function.update d.workTapePos r 0, d.output⟩ := by
  have hcells : ∀ i : ℕ, i < u.length → d.workTapes r ((0 : ℤ) + i) ≠ none := by
    intro i hi
    rw [zero_add, hr, FinTM.bufferTape_nat, ne_eq, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff]
    omega
  have h1 : (xr_extendTM K r).runFrom d u.length = ⟨some .run, d.inputPos, d.workTapes,
      Function.update d.workTapePos r (u.length : ℤ), d.output⟩ := by
    rw [xr_fwd_run (xr_extendTM K r) r (fun inp w s hs => by simp [xr_extendTM, hs])
      u.length 0 d hd hpos hcells, zero_add]
  have hend : (⟨some .run, d.inputPos, d.workTapes,
      Function.update d.workTapePos r (u.length : ℤ), d.output⟩ :
      Cfg K Bool xr_St x).workTapeSymbols r = none := by
    rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
    dsimp only
    rw [Function.update_self, hr, FinTM.bufferTape_nat]
    simp
  have h2 : (xr_extendTM K r).step ⟨some .run, d.inputPos, d.workTapes,
      Function.update d.workTapePos r (u.length : ℤ), d.output⟩ =
      ⟨some (.back true), d.inputPos,
        Function.update d.workTapes r (FinTM.bufferTape (u ++ [false])),
        Function.update d.workTapePos r ((u.length : ℤ) + -1), d.output⟩ := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some rfl,
      show (xr_extendTM K r).tr .run _ _ =
        xr_act (xr_mv1 r (some (some false)) SignType.neg) (some (.back true)) by
          simp only [xr_extendTM]
          rw [hend],
      xr_mv1_apply, xr_cast_neg]
    dsimp only
    rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_idem, Option.getD_some, hr,
      ← FinTM.bufferTape_append]
  have h3 := xr_back_run (xr_extendTM K r) r none
    (fun b inp w s hs => by simp [xr_extendTM, hs]) (fun b inp w hw => by simp [xr_extendTM, hw])
    true 0 u.length
    ⟨some (.back true), d.inputPos, Function.update d.workTapes r (FinTM.bufferTape (u ++ [false])),
      Function.update d.workTapePos r ((u.length : ℤ) + -1), d.output⟩ rfl
    (by dsimp only; rw [Function.update_self]; ring)
    (by
      intro i hi
      dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_self, zero_add, FinTM.bufferTape_nat, ne_eq, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff]
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
      omega)
    (by dsimp only; rw [Function.update_self]; simp)
  have hsplit : (xr_extendTM K r).runFrom d (2 * u.length + 2) =
      (xr_extendTM K r).runFrom ((xr_extendTM K r).step ((xr_extendTM K r).runFrom d u.length))
        (u.length + 1) := by
    rw [show 2 * u.length + 2 = (u.length + 1) + (u.length + 1) by ring,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, ← MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
  rw [hsplit, h1, h2, h3]
  dsimp only
  simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_idem]
  congr 1
  refine congrArg (Function.update d.workTapes r) (funext fun p => ?_)
  dsimp only
  simp only [Option.getD_none, ite_self]

/-! #### Buffer-tape facts needed by the rows (from the published equations only) -/

/-- A stored word is blank at every negative cell. -/
private theorem xr_bufferTape_neg (v : List Bool) (p : ℤ) (hp : p < 0) :
    FinTM.bufferTape v p = none := by
  induction v using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nil]
  | append_singleton L b ih =>
    rw [FinTM.bufferTape_append, Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
    exact ih

/-- A stored word is blank at and beyond its length. -/
private theorem xr_bufferTape_ge (v : List Bool) (p : ℤ) (hp : (v.length : ℤ) ≤ p) :
    FinTM.bufferTape v p = none := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, p = n := ⟨p.toNat, by omega⟩
  rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff]
  omega

/-- A stored word is blank exactly off `[0, |v|)`. -/
private theorem xr_bufferTape_eq_none_iff (v : List Bool) (p : ℤ) :
    FinTM.bufferTape v p = none ↔ p < 0 ∨ (v.length : ℤ) ≤ p := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, p = n := ⟨p.toNat, by omega⟩
    rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff] at h
    omega
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact xr_bufferTape_neg v p h
    · exact xr_bufferTape_ge v p h

/-- A stored word is non-blank on `[0, |v|)`. -/
private theorem xr_bufferTape_ne_none (v : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < v.length) :
    FinTM.bufferTape v i ≠ none := by
  rw [ne_eq, xr_bufferTape_eq_none_iff]
  omega

/-- Blanking the last symbol of a stored word stores its prefix. -/
private theorem xr_bufferTape_pop (L : List Bool) (b : Bool) :
    Function.update (FinTM.bufferTape (L ++ [b])) (L.length : ℤ) none = FinTM.bufferTape L := by
  rw [FinTM.bufferTape_append, Function.update_idem, Function.update_eq_self_iff,
    FinTM.bufferTape_nat]
  exact (List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.mpr le_rfl).symm

/-- The return pass over a stored word with the blanking write clears it entirely. -/
private theorem xr_clear_fun (v : List Bool) :
    (fun p : ℤ => if 0 ≤ p ∧ p < 0 + (v.length : ℤ) then (some none).getD (FinTM.bufferTape v p)
      else FinTM.bufferTape v p) = fun _ => none := by
  funext p
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · rw [xr_bufferTape_eq_none_iff]
    omega

/-! #### The pass, the capture test, the input rewind and the answer -/

/-- **The pass** (the window clear's engine). While the ruler tape `r` reads a symbol, blank the
cell under head `j`, move `j` by `dir` and `r` right; at the ruler's blank, blank once more under
`j` without moving it and start the ruler's return; return the ruler head to its origin. -/
private def xr_passTM (K : ℕ) (j r : Fin K) (dir : SignType) : MultiTapeTM K Bool xr_St where
  q₀ := .run
  tr := fun q _ w =>
    match q with
    | .run =>
      match w r with
      | some _ => xr_act (xr_mv2 j r (some none) dir SignType.pos) (some .run)
      | none => xr_act (xr_mv2 j r (some none) 0 SignType.neg) (some (.back true))
    | .back b =>
      match w r with
      | some _ => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.neg) (some (.back b))
      | none => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.pos) (some (.done b))
    | q => xr_stay q

/-- The pass's forward phase: after `m ≤ |u|` steps, head `j` has moved `m` cells along `dir`,
blanking the cells it left, and the ruler head is at `m`. -/
private theorem xr_pass_fwd {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (j r : Fin K) (hjr : j ≠ r) (dir : SignType)
    (u : List Bool) (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x) (hd : d.state = some .run)
    (hr : d.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape u) (hpos : d.workTapePos r = 0) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : m ≤ u.length) :
    ∃ f : ℤ → Option Bool,
      (xr_passTM K j r dir).runFrom d m =
        ⟨some .run, d.inputPos, Function.update d.workTapes j f,
          fun i => if i = j then d.workTapePos j + m * (dir : ℤ)
            else if i = r then (m : ℤ) else d.workTapePos i, d.output⟩ ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, (∃ i : ℕ, i < m ∧ p = d.workTapePos j + i * (dir : ℤ)) → f p = none) ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, (∀ i : ℕ, i < m → p ≠ d.workTapePos j + i * (dir : ℤ)) →
        f p = d.workTapes j p) := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨d.workTapes j, ?_, fun p ⟨i, hi, _⟩ => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i), fun p _ => rfl⟩
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · exact hd
    · rfl
    · exact (Function.update_eq_self _ _).symm
    · funext i
      dsimp only
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · rw [if_pos hij, hij]
        simp
      · rw [if_neg hij]
        by_cases hir : i = r
        · rw [if_pos hir, hir, hpos]
          simp
        · rw [if_neg hir]
    · rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨f, hrun, hblank, hkeep⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hread : (⟨some .run, d.inputPos, Function.update d.workTapes j f,
        fun i => if i = j then d.workTapePos j + m * (dir : ℤ)
          else if i = r then (m : ℤ) else d.workTapePos i, d.output⟩ :
        Cfg K Bool xr_St x).workTapeSymbols r = some (u[m]'(by omega)) := by
      rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
      dsimp only
      rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hjr), if_pos rfl, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hjr), hr,
        FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
    refine ⟨Function.update f (d.workTapePos j + m * (dir : ℤ)) none, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hrun, MultiTapeTM.step_of_some rfl,
        show (xr_passTM K j r dir).tr .run _ _ =
          xr_act (xr_mv2 j r (some none) dir SignType.pos) (some .run) by
            simp only [xr_passTM]
            rw [hread],
        xr_mv2_apply j r hjr]
      dsimp only
      simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_idem, Option.getD_some,
        if_neg (Ne.symm hjr), xr_cast_pos, ite_true]
      congr 1
      funext i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · simp only [if_pos hij]
        push_cast
        ring
      · by_cases hir : i = r
        · simp only [if_neg hij, if_pos hir]
          push_cast
          ring
        · simp only [if_neg hij, if_neg hir]
    · rintro p ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      by_cases hp : d.workTapePos j + i * (dir : ℤ) = d.workTapePos j + m * (dir : ℤ)
      · rw [hp, Function.update_self]
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hp]
        refine hblank _ ⟨i, ?_, rfl⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hi with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (by rw [h]) hp
    · intro p hp
      rw [Function.update_of_ne (hp m (by omega))]
      exact hkeep p (fun i hi => hp i (by omega))

/-- **The pass's contract.** From the origin of the ruler word `u`, `2|u| + 2` steps move head `j`
by `|u|` cells along `dir`, blank the `|u| + 1` cells it visited, return the ruler head to `0`,
change nothing else, and stop at `done true`.

**Proof sketch.** `xr_pass_fwd` gives the first `|u|` steps: head `j` moves `|u|` cells along
`dir`, blanking each cell it leaves, while the ruler head walks over `u`. At the ruler's right
blank one step blanks the last visited cell and turns the ruler head back, and `xr_back_run`
returns it to `0` in `|u| + 1` steps. The visited cells are `pos + i·dir` for `i ≤ |u|`; every
other cell keeps its symbol. -/
private theorem xr_passTM_run {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (j r : Fin K) (hjr : j ≠ r) (dir : SignType)
    (u : List Bool) (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x) (hd : d.state = some .run)
    (hr : d.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape u) (hpos : d.workTapePos r = 0) :
    ∃ f : ℤ → Option Bool,
      (xr_passTM K j r dir).runFrom d (2 * u.length + 2) =
        ⟨some (.done true), d.inputPos, Function.update d.workTapes j f,
          Function.update d.workTapePos j (d.workTapePos j + u.length * (dir : ℤ)), d.output⟩ ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, (∃ i : ℕ, i ≤ u.length ∧ p = d.workTapePos j + i * (dir : ℤ)) → f p = none) ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, (∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ u.length → p ≠ d.workTapePos j + i * (dir : ℤ)) →
        f p = d.workTapes j p) := by
  obtain ⟨f, hrun, hblank, hkeep⟩ := xr_pass_fwd j r hjr dir u d hd hr hpos u.length le_rfl
  set c₁ : Cfg K Bool xr_St x := ⟨some .run, d.inputPos, Function.update d.workTapes j f,
    fun i => if i = j then d.workTapePos j + u.length * (dir : ℤ)
      else if i = r then (u.length : ℤ) else d.workTapePos i, d.output⟩ with hc₁
  have hread : c₁.workTapeSymbols r = none := by
    rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq, hc₁]
    dsimp only
    rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hjr), if_pos rfl, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hjr), hr,
      FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff]
  set f' : ℤ → Option Bool := Function.update f (d.workTapePos j + u.length * (dir : ℤ)) none
    with hf'
  have h2 : (xr_passTM K j r dir).step c₁ =
      ⟨some (.back true), d.inputPos, Function.update d.workTapes j f',
        fun i => if i = j then d.workTapePos j + u.length * (dir : ℤ)
          else if i = r then (u.length : ℤ) + -1 else d.workTapePos i, d.output⟩ := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some rfl,
      show (xr_passTM K j r dir).tr .run _ _ =
        xr_act (xr_mv2 j r (some none) 0 SignType.neg) (some (.back true)) by
          simp only [xr_passTM]
          rw [hread],
      xr_mv2_apply j r hjr, hc₁]
    dsimp only
    simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_idem, Option.getD_some,
      if_neg (Ne.symm hjr), SignType.coe_zero, add_zero, ite_true]
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · simp [hij]
    · by_cases hir : i = r
      · simp [hir]
      · simp [hij, hir]
  have h3 := xr_back_run (xr_passTM K j r dir) r none
    (fun b inp w s hs => by simp [xr_passTM, hs]) (fun b inp w hw => by simp [xr_passTM, hw])
    true 0 u.length
    ⟨some (.back true), d.inputPos, Function.update d.workTapes j f',
      fun i => if i = j then d.workTapePos j + u.length * (dir : ℤ)
        else if i = r then (u.length : ℤ) + -1 else d.workTapePos i, d.output⟩ rfl
    (by dsimp only; rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hjr), if_pos rfl]; ring)
    (by
      intro i hi
      dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hjr), zero_add, hr]
      exact xr_bufferTape_ne_none u i hi)
    (by
      dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hjr), hr]
      exact xr_bufferTape_neg u _ (by omega))
  refine ⟨f', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsplit : (xr_passTM K j r dir).runFrom d (2 * u.length + 2) =
        (xr_passTM K j r dir).runFrom
          ((xr_passTM K j r dir).step ((xr_passTM K j r dir).runFrom d u.length))
          (u.length + 1) := by
      rw [show 2 * u.length + 2 = (u.length + 1) + (u.length + 1) by ring,
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, ← MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
    rw [hsplit, hrun, h2, h3]
    dsimp only
    congr 1
    · have hG : Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes j f') r
          (fun p => if 0 ≤ p ∧ p < 0 + (u.length : ℤ)
            then none.getD (Function.update d.workTapes j f' r p)
            else Function.update d.workTapes j f' r p) = Function.update d.workTapes j f' := by
        rw [Function.update_eq_self_iff, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hjr)]
        funext p
        simp only [Option.getD_none, ite_self]
      exact hG
    · funext i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · rw [hij, Function.update_of_ne hjr, if_pos rfl, Function.update_self]
      · by_cases hir : i = r
        · rw [hir, Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hjr), hpos]
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne hir, if_neg hij, if_neg hir, Function.update_of_ne hij]
  · rintro p ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    by_cases hp : d.workTapePos j + i * (dir : ℤ) = d.workTapePos j + u.length * (dir : ℤ)
    · rw [hp, hf', Function.update_self]
    · rw [hf', Function.update_of_ne hp]
      refine hblank _ ⟨i, ?_, rfl⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hi with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd (by rw [h]) hp
  · intro p hp
    rw [hf', Function.update_of_ne (hp u.length le_rfl)]
    exact hkeep p (fun i hi => hp i hi.le)

/-- **The capture test.** From the end of the captured output, step left and read the last symbol:
blank (an empty output) exits `done false`; `true` steps left once more and exits `done true` at
a blank there (the output was exactly `[true]`); anything else exits `done false`. Every exit
clears the captured output and returns the head to its origin. -/
private def xr_testTM (K : ℕ) (r : Fin K) : MultiTapeTM K Bool xr_St where
  q₀ := .start
  tr := fun q _ w =>
    match q with
    | .start => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.neg) (some .run)
    | .run =>
      match w r with
      | none => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.pos) (some (.done false))
      | some true => xr_act (xr_mv1 r (some none) SignType.neg) (some .aux)
      | some false => xr_act (xr_mv1 r (some none) SignType.neg) (some (.back false))
    | .aux =>
      match w r with
      | none => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.pos) (some (.done true))
      | some _ => xr_act (xr_mv1 r (some none) SignType.neg) (some (.back false))
    | .back b =>
      match w r with
      | some _ => xr_act (xr_mv1 r (some none) SignType.neg) (some (.back b))
      | none => xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.pos) (some (.done b))
    | q => xr_stay q

/-- The test's clearing tail: from `back false` at the end of the stored word `v`, `|v| + 1` steps
blank it, return the head to `0`, and stop at `done false`. -/
private theorem xr_test_tail {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (r : Fin K) (v : List Bool)
    (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x) (hd : d.state = some (.back false))
    (hr : d.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape v) (hpos : d.workTapePos r = (v.length : ℤ) - 1) :
    (xr_testTM K r).runFrom d (v.length + 1) =
      ⟨some (.done false), d.inputPos, Function.update d.workTapes r (fun _ => none),
        Function.update d.workTapePos r 0, d.output⟩ := by
